Every instance undergoes rigorous, multi-stage curation that directly addresses the quality problems identified in prior benchmarks: issue descriptions are rewritten from scratch to provide precise, unambiguous specifications, and test suites are manually reviewed to remove overly narrow and overly broad tests. Tasks with insufficient complexity or limited cross-file scope are filtered out, yielding a benchmark of challenging, large-scale refactoring tasks that average 11.4 modified files and 261.6 lines of code per instance, substantially exceeding the scale of existing benchmarks. Experiments with frontier models under two agent scaffolds show that the best model achieves only 41.2% resolve rate, confirming that SWE-Bench ProMax presents a meaningful and unsaturated challenge for current AI coding agents. Our benchmark is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/swe-bench-promax/SWE-Bench-ProMax.

</details>


### [366] [RA-FinBERT: Rule-aware LoRA adaptation for low-resource financial sentiment classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09834)
*Fan Zhang,Jiaming Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了RA-FinBERT，一个将LoRA低秩适配与VADER规则情感特征相结合的参数高效框架，用于金融新闻情感分类。该方法仅增加1,024个可训练参数，在测试集上达到69.89%的准确率和0.634的宏F1值，显著优于纯文本FinBERT基线（63.44%准确率、0.526宏F1）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有资源高效的金融NLP研究主要聚焦于压缩或适配预训练语言模型，较少关注将上下文表示与轻量级规则特征相结合。作者希望探索规则派生的情感信息和源元数据能否为FinBERT的上下文表示提供互补信号，在极低参数开销下提升分类性能。

Method: RA-FinBERT将LoRA低秩适配与三种连续的VADER情感比例（正面、负面、中性）及源级元数据特征整合。四个标准化特征向量直接与FinBERT最终层768维[CLS]表示拼接，通过轻量级分类头进行分类。该设计仅引入1,024个额外可训练权重。

Result: 在金融新闻标题和描述的三分类情感任务中，RA-FinBERT达到69.89%准确率和0.634宏F1，优于纯文本FinBERT（63.44%/0.526）和DistilBERT基线。中性类召回率从18.18%提升至45.45%。框架支持CPU和GPU运行。

Conclusion: 规则派生的情感信息和源元数据能够为上下文FinBERT表示提供互补信号，以极小的模型复杂度代价显著提升金融情感分类性能，为计算资源受限场景提供了轻量且实用的解决方案。

Abstract: Financial sentiment analysis converts unstructured financial news into quantitative signals that can support market analysis and decision-making. Existing work on resource-efficient financial NLP has largely focused on compressing or adapting pretrained language models, with less attention to combining contextual representations with lightweight rule-derived features. This study develops Rule-Aware FinBERT (RA-FinBERT), a parameter-efficient framework that integrates low-rank adaptation (LoRA) with three continuous VADER-derived sentiment proportions (positive, negative, and neutral) and a source-level metadata feature. The standardized four-dimensional feature vector is directly concatenated with the 768-dimensional final-layer FinBERT [CLS] representation and passed through a lightweight classification head. This design introduces only 1,024 additional trainable weights relative to a structurally matched text-only FinBERT model. RA-FinBERT was evaluated against text-only FinBERT and a lightweight DistilBERT baseline for three-class sentiment classification of financial-news titles and descriptions. On the held-out test set, RA-FinBERT achieved 69.89% accuracy and a macro F1 score of 0.634, compared with 63.44% and 0.526 for text-only FinBERT. Neutral-class recall increased from 18.18% to 45.45%. The framework supports both CPU and GPU execution, offering a lightweight and practical approach to financial sentiment classification under constrained computational resources. These findings indicate that rule-derived sentiment information and source metadata can provide complementary signals to contextual FinBERT representations and improve performance with minimal additional model complexity.

</details>


### [367] [Fusion Training for Mathematical Generalization in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09893)
*Congfeng Cao,Pengyu Zhang,Jelke Bloem*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了Thinking Mode Fusion（TMF）中思考与非思考两种模式之间的训练动态，聚焦数据比例和训练调度两个关键因素，发现两种模式之间存在非对称交互和固有张力，为TMF训练设置提供了实用指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TMF使大语言模型能在单一模型中同时支持简洁回答和长程推理，但其训练动态（包括两种模式间的数据比例和训练调度）尚未被充分探索，缺乏系统性研究来指导实际训练配置。

Method: 针对数学问题求解，构建了包含多种思考与非思考数据比例以及三种训练调度的基准测试（Fusion Bench），系统分析训练调度和数据比例对TMF效果的影响。

Result: 发现思考与非思考两种模式之间存在非对称交互：增加非思考监督比例会降低思考模式的准确率；不同训练调度会调节这一权衡，最优调度取决于数据比例；量化了非思考与思考模式监督之间的负相关关系，凸显两种模式间的固有张力。

Conclusion: 揭示了TMF训练中两种模式间的内在冲突与权衡机制，为设计有效的TMF训练设置提供了实践指导，并公开发布了代码和数据以支持后续研究。

Abstract: Thinking Mode Fusion (TMF) enables large language models to support both concise responses and long-form reasoning by unifying a non-thinking mode and a thinking mode within a single model. However, its training dynamics, including the \emph{data ratio} and \emph{training schedule} between the two modes, remain underexplored. In this work, we present a systematic study of TMF by analyzing the effects of the training schedule and data ratio between thinking and non-thinking modes. Focusing on mathematical problem solving, we construct a benchmark with multiple thinking-to-non-thinking data ratios and three training schedules. Our results reveal an asymmetric interaction between the two modes: increasing the ratio of non-thinking supervision reduces the accuracy of the thinking mode. We further show that different training schedules modulate this trade-off and that the optimal schedule depends on the data ratio. Finally, we quantify a negative correlation between non-thinking and thinking mode supervision, highlighting an inherent tension between these two modes. These findings provide practical guidance for designing effective TMF training settings. All code and data are released to support further research at: \href{https://github.com/caocongfeng/Fusion-Bench.git}{\textbf{Fusion Bench}}.

</details>


### [368] [Consilience for Verifier-Free Test-Time Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09898)
*Lecheng Kong,Like Hui,Haitao Mao,Jun Huan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文指出现有基于置信度的免验证器测试时扩展（VF-TTS）方法在复杂任务上会灾难性失效，并提出consilience框架，通过显式评估推理过程中置信度的时序不对称性（低初始置信度、高最终置信度）来改进样本选择，在研究生级数学和自由形式代码生成任务上超越现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VF-TTS方法（尤其是基于置信度的）在复杂任务上会失效，因为均匀的高置信度常常意味着探索不足，倾向于选择"自信但错误"的答案。需要一种新的选择机制来引导更稳健的认知搜索过程。

Method: 提出consilience框架，核心是评估置信度的时序不对称性。具体包括：(1) 观测到有效推理需要"低初始置信度→高最终置信度"的轨迹模式；(2) 通过组合度量主动惩罚高初始置信度，同时严格要求最终置信度；(3) 基于此度量对推理轨迹进行排序和选择。

Result: 在研究生级数学问题和自由形式代码生成任务上的大量实验表明，consilience有效超越现有基线方法，验证了"完成置信度"时序视角的有效性。

Conclusion: 置信度的时序模式比静态的最终置信度更能反映推理质量。低初始置信度代表探索性分支，高最终置信度代表收敛到可靠答案。这一发现为免验证器测试时扩展提供了新的研究方向。

Abstract: Test-time scaling often uses an external verifier, such as compilers and test cases in coding or trained value functions in robotics applications, to obtain high-quality rollouts. Verifier-free test-time scaling (or VF-TTS) is gaining extensive attention as a mechanism to enhance Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning, primarily because we do not have access to such high-quality verifiers in many real-world applications. Among existing VF-TTS methods, confidence-based VF-TTS methods, which compute and rank rollouts solely by confidence, are particularly promising. Such methods introduce near-zero overhead for sample evaluation and require minimal access to internal model states, making the methods highly flexible across models and tasks.
  In this paper, we demonstrate a critical limitation of existing confidence-based VF-TTS methods by showing that such methods catastrophically break down on complex tasks. We observe a very interesting phenomenon: uniformly high confidence frequently indicates a failure to explore, favoring confidently wrong answers. To address this, our core insight is that robust cognitive search requires a specific confidence trajectory pattern: such methods perform exploratory branching at the beginning, as manifested by low initial confidence, and converge to a high final confidence solution. To implement this insight, we introduce consilience, a novel selection framework that explicitly evaluates the temporal asymmetry of confidence in reasoning. We operationalize this via a combinatorial metric that actively penalizes high initial confidence while strictly demanding final certainty. Extensive experiments covering both graduate-level mathematics problems and free-form code generation demonstrate that consilience effectively outperforms existing baselines, validating our novel perspective on completion confidence.

</details>


### [369] [Decoding-Level Taboo: A Diagnostic Stress Test for LLM Robustness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09900)
*Tadanobu Chuyo Kamijo,Ori Rottenstreich,Javier Conde,Gonzalo Martínez,Pedro Reviriego*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Decoding-Level Taboo，一种零提示的诊断性压力测试方法，通过在运行时动态屏蔽词边界的首要候选token，强制大语言模型偏离其标称生成路径，从而评估模型在真实部署条件下的离轨鲁棒性。实验表明，模型大小和后训练指令对齐均显著影响离轨鲁棒性，且该方法还可用于合成数据生成、安全护栏压力测试和部署前可靠性审计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型评估通常仅在标称（nominal）条件下进行，忽略了真实部署中系统提示词、安全护栏和结构约束会持续将模型推开其高度优化的生成路径，导致基准分数与部署性能之间存在分歧，缺乏对模型离轨鲁棒性的诊断工具。

Method: 提出Taboo方法，一种零提示、运行时直接干预logit空间的诊断性压力测试。通过动态屏蔽词边界处的主要候选token（primary candidate tokens），强制模型进行"迂回表达"（circumlocution），从而将模型逼离其标称生成路径。

Result: 在多个开源权重模型家族上的评估显示，离轨鲁棒性受参数规模和后训练指令对齐的显著影响，模型越大、对齐越好，鲁棒性通常越好。

Conclusion: Taboo不仅是一种有效的离轨鲁棒性诊断工具，还提供了生成多样化合成数据集、压力测试运行时安全护栏以及部署前模型可靠性审计的新原语。

Abstract: Large language model evaluations typically focus on performance under nominal conditions, creating an illusion of capability where models comfortably walk a narrow, highly optimized generation corridor. In real-world deployments, however, complex system prompts, safety guardrails, and structural constraints continuously force models off this nominal path, driving a divergence between benchmark scores and deployment performance. To address this issue, we introduce Decoding-Level Taboo, a zero-prompt diagnostic stress test that intervenes directly in logit space at runtime, forcing models out of their nominal paths. By dynamically masking primary candidate tokens at word boundaries, Taboo forces machine circumlocution.
  Evaluating Taboo across several open-weight model families reveals that off-path robustness is heavily influenced by both parameter scale and post-training instruction alignment, with robustness generally improving with model size and alignment. Beyond the results presented in this paper, Taboo provides a novel primitive for generating diverse synthetic datasets, stress-testing runtime safety guardrails, and auditing model reliability prior to real-world deployment.

</details>


### [370] [From Values to Benchmarks: Evaluating Large Language Models for Governmental Use in Dutch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09925)
*Laurens Samson,Iva Gornishka,Gossa Lô,Yuki M. Asano,Sennay Ghebreab*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了"Grip on LLMs"框架，这是一个为荷兰政府使用场景设计的系统性大语言模型评估套件。该框架与荷兰某市政组织的领域专家合作开发，通过顾问委员会、用户研究和公务员聊天机器人用户调查，确定了六个评估维度（事实性、诚实性、社会偏见、能耗、成本和训练数据透明度），并将其操作化为涵盖30多个多语言及荷兰语特定模型的基准套件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地被部署在政府环境中，但现有评估框架很少同时反映公共管理的价值观和非英语语境的语言要求。因此需要一个能够同时满足这两方面需求的评估框架。

Method: 采用多阶段研究方法：通过顾问委员会流程、用户研究以及公务员聊天机器人用户调查来识别评估维度；然后将六个评估维度操作化为基准套件，涵盖30多个多语言和荷兰语特定模型进行系统评估。

Result: 研究发现：没有任何单一模型能在所有维度上表现出色，权衡不可避免——更高质量始终伴随更大的环境影响和财务成本，而偏见与两者基本无关；事实性与诚实性由不同属性决定，高事实性并不意味着高诚实性。

Conclusion: 为使研究发现对非技术受众具有可操作性，研究发布了一个公开可访问、用户友好的模型概览平台，面向政府LLM选择过程中从工程师到政策制定者的所有利益相关者。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly being deployed in governmental settings, yet few existing evaluation frameworks jointly reflect the values of public administration and the linguistic requirements of non-English contexts. We present the "Grip on LLMs" framework, a systematic evaluation suite for Dutch governmental use developed in collaboration with domain experts from a major Dutch municipal organisation. Through an advisory board process, user research, and a survey of the users of a civil-servant chatbot, we identify six evaluation dimensions (factuality, honesty, social bias, energy consumption, cost, and training data transparency) and operationalise them into a benchmark suite covering more than 30 multilingual and Dutch-specific models. Our results reveal that no single model excels across all dimensions, and that trade-offs are unavoidable: higher quality consistently comes at greater environmental impact and financial cost, while bias remains largely independent of both. We further find that factuality (whether a model answers correctly) and honesty (whether a model acknowledges what it does not know) are governed by distinct properties, with high factuality not implying high honesty. To make these findings actionable for non-technical audiences, we release a publicly accessible, user-friendly model overview designed for the full range of stakeholders involved in governmental LLM selection, from engineers to policymakers.

</details>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [371] [Application of Artificial Intelligence for Fraudulent Banking Operations Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07471)
*Bohdan Mytnyk,Oleksandr Tkachyk,Nataliya Shakhovska,Solomiia Fedushko,Yuriy Syerov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了利用机器学习算法识别银行欺诈交易的问题。由于新冠疫情推动大量业务转向线上平台，银行欺诈变得更加普遍。研究提出了基于人工神经网络的欺诈检测模型，并通过处理不平衡数据集、特征变换和特征工程等方法提升检测精度。实验结果表明逻辑回归算法表现最佳（AUC约0.946），而堆叠泛化方法取得更优的AUC值0.954。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新冠疫情导致大量银行业务转移到线上平台，同时催生了许多可被犯罪分子利用的慈善基金，使得银行欺诈问题日益严重。因此，开发有效的自动化欺诈检测工具对于保护用户资金安全和维护数字社会信任至关重要。

Method: 本文采用多种机器学习算法进行银行欺诈交易识别，核心方法包括：1）开发人工神经网络（ANN）模型作为主要检测工具；2）使用多种数据预处理技术，包括处理高度不平衡数据集、特征变换和特征工程；3）比较多种算法性能，并采用堆叠泛化（stacked generalization）策略集成多种模型以提升检测效果。

Result: 实验结果显示，在各项算法中逻辑回归算法表现最优，AUC值约为0.946；而采用堆叠泛化方法后，AUC进一步提升至0.954，表明集成方法能有效提高欺诈检测的准确性。

Conclusion: 人工智能算法在识别银行欺诈方面具有有效性和实用价值，尤其是在新冠疫情后数字化程度更高的社会环境中。通过合理的数据预处理和模型集成策略，可以显著提升欺诈检测的准确率，为银行反欺诈系统提供可靠的技术支持。

Abstract: This study considers the task of applying artificial intelligence to recognize bank fraud. In recent years, due to the COVID19 pandemic, bank fraud has become even more common due to the massive transition of many operations to online platforms and the creation of many charitable funds that criminals can use to deceive users. The present work focuses on machine learning algorithms as a tool well suited for analyzing and recognizing online banking transactions. The study`s scientific novelty is the development of machine learning models for identifying fraudulent banking transactions and techniques for preprocessing bank data for further comparison and selection of the best results. This paper also details various methods for improving detection accuracy, i.e., handling highly imbalanced datasets, feature transformation, and feature engineering. The proposed model, which is based on an artificial neural network, effectively improves the accuracy of fraudulent transaction detection. The results of the different algorithms are visualized, and the logistic regression algorithm performs the best, with an output AUC value of approximately 0,946. The stacked generalization shows a better AUC of 0.954. The recognition of banking fraud using artificial intelligence algorithms is a topical issue in our digital society.

</details>


### [372] [Data-Driven Fire-Zone Segmentation for Improved Short-Term Wildfire Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07472)
*Nicolas Caron,Christophe Guyeux,Hassan Noura,Benjamin Aynes*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文挑战了野火预测中均匀网格离散化的传统范式，提出基于分水岭检测与K-means聚类的无监督火区分割算法，直接用历史火灾模式定义预测单元。在法国六个省和六个预测模型上验证，火区分割比网格方法一致提升3-6%的IoU，且计算轻量（<10秒）、完全可并行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统野火预测模型将研究区域离散化为均匀网格，忽略了火灾点位的空间异质性分布。作者认为数据离散化方式比模型选择更为关键，这一认识挑战了现有研究范式，促使他们探索更好的空间分区方法。

Method: 提出一个无监督火区分割算法，结合分水岭检测（watershed detection）与K-means聚类，直接从历史火灾分布模式中定义预测单元，替代传统的均匀网格离散化。

Result: 在法国六个省、跨越六个预测模型的实验中，火区分割方法一致优于基于网格的方法，平均IoU提升3-6%（取决于空间尺度）；计算开销极低（每个配置<10秒），且完全可并行化。

Conclusion: 优化空间离散化能够为短期野火预测带来显著且可复现的性能提升，表明数据分区策略是比模型选择更值得关注的关键因素。

Abstract: Wildfire prediction models typically discretize study areas into uniform grids, ignoring the heterogeneous spatial distribution of ignitions. We challenge this paradigm by showing that how data is discretized matters more than which model is used. We propose an unsupervised fire-zone segmentation algorithm combining watershed detection with K-means clustering to define prediction units directly from historical fire patterns. Experiments across six French departments and six forecasting models show that fire-zone segmentation consistently outperforms grid-based approaches, with mean IoU improvements of +3--6% depending on spatial scale. The method is computationally lightweight (<10s per configuration) and fully parallelizable. Our results demonstrate that optimizing spatial discretization yields significant, reproducible performance gains for short-term wildfire forecasting.

</details>


### [373] [Evolving Safety Landscape of Multi-modal Large Language Models: A Survey of Emerging Threats and Safeguards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07535)
*Xi Li,Shu Zhao,Xiaohan Zou,Fei Zhao,Fuxiao Liu,Yusen Zhang,Cheng Han,Yushun Dong,Jiaqi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文是一篇系统性的综述论文，全面分析了多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）中不断演变的安全格局。论文提出了一个多模态基础的安全威胁分类体系，分析了威胁模型的变化，并总结了MLLM安全策略的最新进展和未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型通过模态对齐和融合带来更强能力，但同时也重塑了机器学习的安全格局。模型复杂度和跨模态交互的增加引发了新的安全威胁（如模态集成受损、模态错位、融合安全风险），而现有的基于单模态学习的框架无法捕捉这些新约束，因此亟需系统性分析MLLM的安全格局。

Method: 论文首先提出一个多模态基础的威胁分类体系（涵盖对抗攻击、数据投毒、越狱和幻觉），分析威胁模型的转变；然后总结更新的安全假设，并据此组织近期MLLM安全策略的研究进展；最后讨论开放挑战和未来方向。

Result: 提供了一个系统的MLLM安全格局分析框架，包括多模态威胁分类、威胁模型转变的分析、安全策略的整理以及开放问题的识别。

Conclusion: 论文旨在推动更原则性和可扩展的多模态系统安全机制的发展，指出了现有框架在单模态范式下的局限性，并为未来研究和安全机制设计提供了指导方向。

Abstract: Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) integrate heterogeneous modalities through modality alignment and fusion, enabling stronger understanding and reasoning. However, this architectural shift reshapes the safety landscape of machine learning. Increased model complexity and cross-modal interactions give rise to novel threats, including compromised modality integration, modality misalignment, and fused safety risks, reflecting shifts in threat modeling beyond uni-modal assumptions. These shifts, in turn, impose new constraints on safety solutions not captured by existing frameworks rooted in uni-modal learning. Motivated by these challenges, this survey provides a systematic analysis of the evolving safety landscape of MLLMs. We first propose a multimodal grounded taxonomy of safety threats and analyze shifts in threat models, covering adversarial attacks, data poisoning, jailbreaks, and hallucinations. We then summarize updated safety assumptions and organize recent advances in MLLM safety strategies accordingly. Finally, we discuss open challenges and future directions to inform the development of more principled and scalable safety mechanisms for multimodal systems.

</details>


### [374] [Tracing sources of epistemic uncertainty in deep learning predictions: homo- and hetero-scedastic linearized estimators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07630)
*Pierre Nodet,Thomas George*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对深度学习中不确定性量化的问题，在贝叶斯深度学习框架下，同时量化均值和方差的交叉协方差，捕捉局部数据稀缺性。提出在线性模型下对激活或权重进行线性化的方法来对信息矩阵进行对角近似，并结合柯西估计方法导出闭式解。将方差预测中采用对角近似的可行性归因于平均梯度外积（AGOP）的存在，表明这种对角近似方法比现有其他对角方法有更高的准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习中不确定性量化对于可靠决策至关重要，但现有方法通常只关注单一来源的不确定性，难以清晰区分偶然不确定性（aleatoric）和认知不确定性（epistemic/局部数据稀缺）各自对测试点的影响。作者希望利用经典统计估计器为现代深度学习提供更清晰的不确定性归因。

Method: 作者将两种经典统计估计器（用于量化不确定性）适配到现代深度学习中，利用近似Fisher信息矩阵的最新进展来实现可扩展到实际架构的规模，从而分别量化偶然不确定性和由局部数据稀缺引起的不确定性。

Result: 实验结果表明，每个测试点受到两种不确定性来源的影响程度不同，验证了所提出的估计器在实际应用中提升模型鲁棒性的实用价值。

Conclusion: 该工作通过将经典统计估计器与近似Fisher信息矩阵相结合，成功实现了对深度学习模型不确定性来源的细粒度归因，为提升真实世界应用的鲁棒性提供了实用的工具和洞察。

Abstract: We adapt two classical statistical estimators for quantifying uncertainty to modern deep learning, in order to provide clearer insights into uncertainty attributable to two sources : aleatoric uncertainty, or locally scarce data. Our approach leverages recent advances in approximate Fisher Information Matrices, to enable scaling to actual architectures. Experimental results demonstrate how each test points is differentially impacted by both sources, highlighting the practical utility of our estimators in improving the robustness of real-world applications.

</details>


### [375] [SkillConsist: Detecting Inconsistencies in Agent Skills via Bidirectional Graph Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07639)
*Chaofan Meng,Yuhang Zheng,Yingnan Zhou,Sihan Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SkillConsist是一个用于检测LLM Agent技能（Skill）声明与实现之间一致性的框架。它通过LLM将声明和实现内容分离为行为记录，构建双向行为图，通过图对齐和图差异分析来检测不一致性，在633个技能基准上达到87.93%的F1值，比最佳基线提高20.43个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent技能的不一致性可能暴露未披露的危险行为或导致错误的技能选择。现有方法依赖预定义类别或声明范围来评估行为，但声明与实现行为可能混合在文本和代码中，且简洁的声明可能对应多个连接的实现步骤，现有方法难以处理这些挑战。

Method: SkillConsist包含三个核心步骤：(1) 使用LLM将声明和实现内容分离为行为记录，结合静态分析补充实现记录；(2) 分别构建声明侧和实现侧的行为图；(3) 从任一侧的行为记录出发，进行双向图对齐搜索候选子图并沿行为关系扩展，最后通过图差异分析识别对齐子图间的冲突并输出检测结果。

Result: 在由ClawHub上500个最热门公共技能和133个Skill-Inject包组成的633技能基准上（含319个不一致和314个一致技能），SkillConsist在包级检测上达到86.85%精确率、89.03%召回率和87.93%的F1值，比最佳基线提升20.43个百分点；在局部定位上达到67.60%精确率、58.14%召回率和62.52%的F1值。

Conclusion: SkillConsist通过图对齐和图差异分析的方法有效解决了Agent技能声明与实现一致性检测中的文本/代码混合和声明-实现步骤映射复杂性两大挑战，显著提升了检测性能，为Agent技能安全验证提供了更可靠的方案。

Abstract: Agent Skills provide reusable capabilities to LLM agents. Agent Skill inconsistencies can expose undisclosed dangerous behavior or cause wrong Skill selection. Recent Agent Skill research has increasingly examined Agent Skill consistency detection. Existing methods evaluate behaviors or security-property graphs against predefined categories or declared scopes. More recently, PL-HCL uses an LLM-based model to learn consistency across metadata, instructions, and resources. However, declaration and implementation behavior can be mixed across text and code, and a concise declaration can correspond to multiple connected implementation steps. We present SkillConsist to address both challenges. An LLM separates declaration and implementation content into behavior records on the implementation and declaration sides, while static analysis supplements implementation records. These records form declaration and implementation behavior graphs, respectively. Starting from a behavior record on either side, bidirectional graph alignment searches the other graph for a candidate subgraph and expands it along behavior relations until it completely expresses the source-side behavior. Graph differencing identifies conflicts between aligned subgraphs and outputs the detection results. We construct a 633-Skill benchmark from ClawHub's 500 most-downloaded public Skills and 133 Skill-Inject packages. The benchmark contains 319 inconsistent and 314 consistent Skills and 442 localized inconsistency annotations. On this benchmark, SkillConsist achieves 86.85% precision, 89.03% recall, and 87.93% F1 for package-level detection, improving F1 over the best baseline by 20.43 percentage points. For localization, it achieves 67.60% precision, 58.14% recall, and 62.52% F1.

</details>


### [376] [PhysAttNet: Enhancing Predictive Performance in Industrial and Astrophysical Time Series via Physics-Informed Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07681)
*Amal Saadallah,Julia Tjus,Petra Wiederkeher,Wolfgang Rhode*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PhysAttNet，一个物理信息引导的注意力框架，用于时间序列预测。它通过在轻量级CNN预测器上附加受领域信息正则化约束的注意力头，施加三种约束（对齐、平滑性、稀疏性），在不需标注的情况下将物理先验知识融入模型，并在铣削切削力和耀变体耀斑预测两个应用中验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在制造监控与天体物理事件检测等物理过程应用中，时间序列预测模型需在噪声和不确定性下保持鲁棒，并捕捉具有物理意义的时间局部结构。CNN虽高效，但其学到的时序表征常表现出不稳定或物理不一致的注意力模式，损害鲁棒性、泛化性和可解释性。

Method: PhysAttNet在轻量级CNN预测器上引入由领域信息正则化引导的注意力头。训练时施加三种互补约束：(1) 对齐正则化，鼓励注意力遵循由输入信号导出的平滑、峰值居中的时间结构；(2) 平滑性正则化，确保连续的时间演化；(3) 稀疏性正则化，促进对信息区间进行选择性聚焦。这些可微的正则项在不需人工标注解释的情况下引入物理引导的归纳偏置。

Result: 在两个不同的应用场景（铣削过程中的切削力预测和耀变体时间序列的耀斑预测）中，PhysAttNet相比基线方法提升了预测精度、泛化能力，以及对结构重要事件的预测性能。

Conclusion: 物理信息引导的注意力正则化能够有效提升时间序列预测模型在噪声和不确定性环境下的鲁棒性、泛化性和可解释性，验证了将领域物理知识以可微正则化形式融入深度学习模型的价值。

Abstract: Accurate and robust time series forecasting is essential in many applications involving physical processes, such as manufacturing monitoring and astrophysical event detection. In these settings, predictive models must remain reliable under noise, variability, and measurement uncertainty while capturing temporally localized structures corresponding to physically meaningful events. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are widely used for such tasks due to their computational efficiency and strong representational capacity. However, their learned temporal representations often exhibit unstable or physically inconsistent attention patterns, reducing robustness, generalization, and interpretability. This paper introduces PhysAttNet, a physics-informed attention framework for time series forecasting. PhysAttNet augments a lightweight CNN forecaster with an attention head guided by domain-informed regularization reflecting the structural properties of physical signals. Specifically, three complementary constraints are imposed during training: an alignment regularization that encourages attention to follow smooth, peak-centered temporal structures derived from the input signal, a smoothness regularization that enforces continuous temporal evolution, and a sparsity regularization that promotes selective focus on informative intervals. These differentiable regularization terms introduce physics-guided inductive bias without requiring annotated explanations or manual supervision. Experiments on two distinct applications, namely predicting cutting forces during milling and forecasting flares in blazar time series, demonstrate that PhysAttNet improves forecasting accuracy, generalization, and prediction performance on structurally important events.

</details>


### [377] [CODS: Iterative Bellman-Residual Data Selection for Reusable Offline Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07719)
*Ibne Farabi Shihab,Sanjeda Akter,Abu Sa-Adat Mohamed Moon-Im Al Ahsan,Md Najmus Swaqeeb,Anuj Sharma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了CODS，一种由评论家引导的离线强化学习数据子集选择方法，通过交替拟合算法匹配的评论家和获取高残差转换来生成可复用的静态子集，在10%预算下保留96.6%的合格池性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线强化学习从固定转换池重复训练策略，跨种子和超参数会导致冗余数据成本高昂；而朴素子采样可能移除长时序信用分配所需的稀有转换。

Method: CODS交替进行两个步骤：拟合与算法匹配的评论家，然后获取高残差转换，最后冻结可复用子集。与优先经验回放不同，它生成静态产物；与一次性残差选择不同，它随评论家变化刷新评分。

Result: 在10%预算下，CODS在20个有效的D4RL任务-算法单元中保留96.6%的合格池性能。在19/20个单元上超过ReDOR和OPER，在20/20上超过其他所有子集基线。五次获取轮次比一轮提升11.23分。整个轨迹扩展在ALFWorld保留95.4%成功率，GSM8K保留96.5%精确匹配。

Conclusion: CODS是一种可复用的选择程序而非正式的coreset保证，等通量和等小时评估表明计算优势来自重用而非单次运行加速。

Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning repeatedly trains policies from a fixed transition pool, making redundant data costly across seeds and hyperparameters, while naive subsampling can remove rare transitions needed for long-horizon credit assignment. We introduce CODS, a critic-guided selector that alternates between fitting an algorithm-matched critic and acquiring high-residual transitions before freezing a reusable subset. Unlike prioritized replay, CODS produces a static artifact; unlike one-shot residual selection, it refreshes scores as the critic changes. At a 10\% budget, CODS retains 96.6\% of eligible-pool performance across 20 valid D4RL task--algorithm cells. It exceeds ReDOR and OPER on 19/20 cells and every other subset baseline on 20/20; all six subset advantages remain significant under predeclared hierarchical inference with Holm correction. Holding total selector updates fixed, five acquisition rounds improve four representative cells by 11.23 points over one round and saturate thereafter. Equal-pass and equal-hour evaluations clarify that reuse, rather than a single-run speedup, creates the compute advantage. Mechanism and corruption interventions expose both useful sparse-reward enrichment and sensitivity to outliers. Finally, a whole-trace extension retains 95.4\% of pooled ALFWorld success and 96.5\% of pooled GSM8K exact match. CODS is therefore a reusable selection procedure, not a formal coreset guarantee.

</details>


### [378] [Neural Operators for Immersed-Boundary Soft Swimmers Locomotion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07722)
*Mohammad Sadegh Eshaghi,Yizheng Wang,Navid Valizadeh,Xiaoying Zhuang,Timon Rabczuk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文开发了神经算子代理模型，用于预测平面和体积鳗鱼游泳者产生的流体动力学场的时间演化。平面模型联合预测速度、涡量和压力，全局相对L²误差为3.51%；体积模型采用三个目标特定模型分别预测三维速度、涡量和压力，误差分别为3.44%、5.58%和19.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高保真浸没边界法模拟虽然能解析变形游泳者与其周围流动的耦合运动，但计算成本高昂，限制了其在工程设计、参数研究和控制中的重复评估需求。因此需要开发高效的代理模型来加速这些重复计算。

Method: 采用神经算子作为代理模型，在自适应流固耦合模拟导出的规则网格场上进行训练，以游泳者几何形状和雷诺数为条件。平面模型联合预测两个速度分量、标量涡量和压力；体积模型采用三个具有共同多通道输入的目标特定模型，分别预测三维速度、涡量和压力。

Result: 平面模型在五个留出的高雷诺数轨迹上，全域全局相对L²误差为3.51%。体积模型的三个模型在五个留出的范围内轨迹上，全域全局相对L²误差分别为3.44%（速度）、5.58%（涡量）和19.2%（压力）。

Conclusion: 研究证明了针对移动边界游泳者流动的场分辨神经代理模型是可行的，同时指出压力精度和物理一致性是未来进一步发展的优先方向。

Abstract: High-fidelity immersed-boundary simulation resolves the coupled motion of a deforming swimmer and its surrounding flow, but the resulting cost limits repeated evaluations for engineering design, parameter studies, and control. We develop neural-operator surrogates for temporal prediction of the hydrodynamic fields generated by planar and volumetric eel swimmers. The surrogates are trained on regular-grid fields exported from adaptive fluid--structure simulations and are conditioned on swimmer geometry and Reynolds number. The planar model jointly predicts two velocity components, scalar vorticity, and pressure. On five held-out high-Reynolds-number trajectories, its full-domain global relative L^2 error is 3.51 %. The volumetric formulation uses three target-specific models with a common multichannel input: one model predicts three-dimensional velocity, one predicts vorticity, and one predicts pressure. Their full-domain global relative L^2 errors on five held-out within-range trajectories are 3.44 %, 5.58 %, and 19.2 %. Together, the results demonstrate the feasibility of field-resolved neural surrogates for moving-boundary swimmer flows while identifying pressure accuracy and physical consistency as priorities for further development.

</details>


### [379] [Finite Constant Frontiers and Auditable Regret Certificates for Average-Reward Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07725)
*Ibne Farabi Shihab,Abu Sa-Adat Mohamed Moon-Im Al Ahsan,Md Najmus Swaqeeb*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种常数感知的比较协议，用于比较平均奖励强化学习中不同算法的遗憾界。作者构造了一个显式的有限下界证书（由两状态块的二叉树构成），在多种条件下将已发表的系数从0.015提升至最高0.0291（提升94%），极限系数为1/32·√((A-3)/A)。同时给出了一个可审计的上界组合规则，并进行了全面的诊断测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平均奖励强化学习的遗憾界虽然在对数因子上已知，但已发表的保证在数值内容上难以比较，因为概率模式、结构参数、对数归一化、先验信息和规划假设各不相同。这使得研究者无法判断哪个算法在实际常数意义上更优，需要一个统一的比较框架。

Method: 提出常数感知比较协议，用两状态块的二叉树构造有限下界证书；使用精确的轨迹级伯努利KL散度进行证明，显式保持动作预算、直径、占用率、导航成本和终端偏置。推导封闭形式的包络以改进已发表的系数，并给出跨度约束乐观学习者的可审计组合规则。此外形式化了有效期望转换和常数可比性，并通过受控诊断测试验证。

Result: 有限下界证书将已发表系数从0.015提升到中等情形的0.0200和更强条件下的0.0291（提升94%），极限系数为1/32·√((A-3)/A)。诊断测试验证了直径依赖、宽度交互效应、跨度误设和有限下界证书在其精确族上的行为。

Conclusion: 本文提供了一个系统的常数级比较框架，显著改进了已有的下界系数，并为上界提供了可审计的组合规则。但自适应方向方差和规划证书仍然开放，上界系数暂不声明。

Abstract: Average-reward reinforcement-learning regret is known up to logarithmic factors, but the numerical content of published guarantees is difficult to compare because probability mode, structural parameter, logarithmic normalization, prior information, and planning assumptions differ. We introduce a constant-aware comparison protocol and derive an explicit finite lower certificate for communicating MDPs. The construction is a binary tree of two-state blocks; its proof uses exact trajectory-level Bernoulli KL divergence and keeps action budget, diameter, occupancy, navigation cost, and terminal bias explicit. A common closed-form envelope improves the published coefficient $0.015$ across a finite frontier: $0.0200$ in a moderate regime and up to $0.0291$ under stronger action, diameter, and horizon conditions, a $94\%$ increase. The limiting coefficient is $\frac1{32}\sqrt{(A-3)/A}$. For upper bounds, we give an auditable composition rule for a span-constrained optimistic learner, but do not claim a coefficient while adaptive directional-variance and planning certificates remain open. We also formalize valid expectation conversion and constant comparability. Controlled diagnostics test diameter dependence, bonus-by-width interactions, span misspecification, and the finite lower certificate on its exact family.

</details>


### [380] [LUCID: Latent-Skill Unified Control via Imagined Dynamics for Long-Horizon Humanoid Loco-Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07746)
*Cheng Guo,Mingzhe Ni,Angelo Cangelosi,Arash Ajoudani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LUCID，一种用于长时域人形机器人移动操作的层次化模型强化学习框架。它通过训练潜在条件化的低层技能策略（通过对抗模仿学习），然后冻结该策略，同时联合学习高层决策策略和宏动力学世界模型。世界模型预测由潜在决策引起的时域扩展状态转移，使得高层策略可以通过想象推演进行优化。实验表明，LUCID在复杂多目标重排任务中显著优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的人形机器人长时域移动操作方法通常将预训练技能与脚本化规划器、有限状态机或任务特定的无模型策略相结合，这限制了它们处理复杂任务序列的能力。需要一种能够自主规划、组合可重用技能的方法来应对复杂的顺序任务。

Method: LUCID采用层次化模型强化学习框架：(1) 首先通过对抗模仿学习训练一个结构化潜在条件化的低层策略（技能库）；(2) 冻结低层策略，联合学习高层策略和宏动力学世界模型；(3) 世界模型预测由潜在高层决策引起的时域扩展状态转移，从而实现高层策略通过想象推演进行优化。

Result: 在多种模拟多目标重排场景中，LUCID相比基线方法在完整任务成功率和部分完成率上均有显著提升，验证了其在复杂顺序移动操作任务中的有效性。

Conclusion: LUCID通过将可重用技能与学习到的世界模型相结合，实现了高层策略的想象推演优化，为长时域人形机器人位置操作提供了一种有效的层次化解决方案，克服了传统脚本化规划或有限状态机方法的局限性。

Abstract: Long-horizon humanoid loco-manipulation requires composing versatile whole-body skills and reliable high-level decision making. Existing methods often coordinate pretrained skills with scripted planners, finite-state machines or task-specific model-free policies, restricting their ability to handle complex task sequences. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{LUCID}, a hierarchical model-based reinforcement learning framework that plans over reusable skills through imagined rollouts of a learned dynamics model. LUCID first trains a structured latent-conditioned low-level policy via adversarial imitation and then freezes it while jointly learning a high-level policy and macro-dynamics world model. The world model predicts the temporally extended state transitions induced by latent decisions, enabling high-level policy optimization through imagined rollouts. We evaluate our framework across various simulated multi-object rearrangement scenarios. Experimental results show that LUCID improves the full-task success and partial-completion rates compared to prior baseline methods, demonstrating its effectiveness in complex sequential loco-manipulation tasks.

</details>


### [381] [From Benchmark Performance to Tool Deployment: Human-in-the-Loop Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07770)
*Mike Szklarzewski,CJ George,Gavin Smithson,Christopher Stokes,Dakota Fulp,William M. Jones,Benjamin Wynn,Alexander Ur,Agit Yesiloz,Clint Kallenbach,Mark Swartz,Nathan DeBardeleben,Sharmistha Chakrabarti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在BowTie制造数据集上评估了19种无监督异常检测模型，发现其在真实工业条件下的性能远不如在MVTec AD等标准基准上稳定，对预处理高度敏感且缺乏统一鲁棒的方法。基于此，作者开发并部署了一个统一的人机协同检测框架，结合图像标注、AI辅助缺陷检测和验证引擎，用于制造件检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动异常检测方法在学术基准上表现优异，但在真实工业环境下的行为尚不明确。本文旨在弥合基准性能与部署现实之间的差距，评估模型在具有反射表面、细微缺陷和轮廓差异化真实制造数据上的实际表现。

Method: 首先在BowTie数据集上系统评估19种无监督异常检测模型，并与MVTec AD基准结果对比；随后基于发现的问题，开发了一个人机协同框架，集成图像标注、AI辅助检测（含热力图引导的缺陷审查、SAM细化候选区域）、掩膜评估和审查历史记录等模块。

Result: 模型在BowTie数据集上表现不稳定，对预处理高度敏感，不同条件下结果不一致，没有单一方法表现出统一鲁棒性；共识审计表明正常数据质量影响部署。提出的框架已初步部署，替代了原有手动目检和文档记录流程。

Conclusion: 研究凸显了基准性能与部署现实之间的鸿沟，并提供了一个实用的人机协同框架来解决这一问题，强调在真实工业条件下评估模型和引入人类反馈机制的重要性。

Abstract: Automated anomaly detection methods often report strong performance on curated academic benchmarks, but their behavior under real-world industrial conditions is less clear. In this work, we evaluate 19 unsupervised anomaly detection models on the BowTie dataset, a challenging manufacturing dataset with reflective surfaces, subtle defects, and profile-specific variation. In contrast to benchmark results, we observe that model performance is less stable than typically reported on standard benchmarks such as MVTec AD, highly sensitive to preprocessing, and inconsistent across conditions, with no single approach emerging as uniformly robust; a consensus audit further indicates that nominal-data quality affects deployment.
  Motivated by these findings, we developed and initially deployed a unified human-in-the-loop framework for manufactured-part inspection that combines image annotation, AI-assisted defect detection, and an integrated validation engine, replacing a prior manual visual inspection and documentation workflow. The system supports heatmap-guided defect review, SAM-refined candidate regions for inspector acceptance, rejection, or boundary adjustment, mask evaluation where annotations exist, and review history for inspector consistency and onboarding. Together, the results highlight the gap between benchmark performance and deployment reality, and provide a practical framework for addressing it.

</details>


### [382] [The Sample Complexity of Policy Learning with Mu-Resets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07772)
*Gene Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了μ-重置交互协议下基于策略的强化学习，解决了关于策略可实现性在样本复杂度中作用的问题。研究发现：在有限全策略集中系数下，样本复杂度下界为exp(Ω(H))；在有限前推集中系数下，样本复杂度对地平线H的依赖被刻画为exp(Θ(√H))。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者旨在解决Kakade和Langford提出的μ-重置交互协议下策略强化学习中的开放问题，即策略可实现性（policy realizability）在样本复杂度中扮演的角色。核心动机是厘清样本复杂度对地平线H的依赖关系，这取决于重置分布所满足的覆盖性（concentrability）条件。

Method: 作者通过理论分析来研究策略强化学习在μ-重置协议下的样本复杂度。具体方法包括：(1) 在有限全策略集中系数（bounded all-policy concentrability）假设下，证明样本复杂度的指数下界；(2) 在有限前推集中系数（bounded pushforward concentrability）假设下，建立将地平线依赖严格刻画为exp(Θ(√H))的结果。通过对比两种覆盖性条件，揭示地平线依赖的根本差异。

Result: 主要结果包括两个定理：(1) 在有限全策略集中系数下，样本复杂度下界为exp(Ω(H))，表明此时问题在长地平线下本质上困难；(2) 在有限前推集中系数下，样本复杂度对地平线的依赖被精确刻画为exp(Θ(√H))，显著改善了指数依赖。这两个结果共同阐明了策略可实现性和覆盖性条件选择对样本复杂度的决定性影响。

Conclusion: 本文完整解决了KLS25提出的开放问题，表明在μ-重置协议下，覆盖性条件（全策略集中系数与前推集中系数）的选择直接决定了样本复杂度对地平线的指数依赖性质差异（从exp(H)改善到exp(√H)）。这一发现为策略强化学习的样本复杂度分析提供了精确的理论边界。

Abstract: We study policy-based reinforcement learning under the $μ$-resets interaction protocol of Kakade and Langford [KL02]. This interaction protocol enables the learner to sample trajectories from a given exploratory reset distribution $μ$, in addition to the starting distribution. We resolve the question raised by [KLS25] on the role of policy realizability for the sample complexity of this problem. Critically, the dependence on horizon $H$ is governed by the notion of coverage assumed of the reset distribution. Under bounded all-policy concentrability, we show a $\exp(Ω(H))$ sample complexity lower bound; with bounded pushforward concentrability, we show the dependence on horizon is tightly characterized as $\exp(Θ(\sqrt H))$.

</details>


### [383] [Shape Mutating Expert Compression:LorExperts and BTExperts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07814)
*Inesh Chakrabarti,Sourjya Roy,Bowen Bao,Thiago Crepaldi,Spandan Tiwari,Ashish Sirasao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了LorExperts，一种保留路由器的MoE压缩方法。它基于专家权重近正交但存在功能共激活社区的特性，将专家聚类，每个聚类保留一个全精度主导专家，其余专家用低秩校正表示。在Qwen3-30B-A3B和Gemma-4-26B-A4B上约50%压缩率下，在多数任务上优于基线（尤其优于D^2-MoE，且优势随专家数E增长）。还提出了重构微调过程和BTExperts树组织以实现推理时共享计算分摊。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多路专家（MoE）语言模型虽然容量大、每token计算成本低，但部署需要压缩大量专家权重矩阵。现有方法的局限：专家剪枝/合并牺牲精度且需重训路由器；低秩delta分解（如D^2-MoE）虽保留全部专家和路由器，但在专家数量增多时性能急剧下降，因为单一共享组件无法近似大量近似正交的专家。<br>核心洞察：MoE专家权重虽近似正交（导致单一共享组件扩展性差），但专家实际上组织成功能性共激活社区，且这种社区与权重相似性解耦。

Method: 1. 基于专家功能共激活社区（而非权重相似性）进行专家聚类。<br>2. 每个聚类保留一个全精度"主导"专家（dominant）。<br>3. 聚类内其余专家以低秩校正（low-rank corrections）相对其局部主导专家表示。<br>4. 保留所有专家和原始路由器（无需重训路由器）。<br>5. 提出重构微调（reconstruction fine-tuning）程序。<br>6. 提出BTExperts：主导专家和校正的树形组织，支持推理时的共享计算分摊（amortization）。

Result: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B和Gemma-4-26B-A4B上约50%专家压缩率下，LorExperts在多数任务上比基线（REAP、D^2-MoE等）更好地保持下游准确率和困惑度；与D^2-MoE相比的优势随专家数量E增长而扩大。

Conclusion: LorExperts通过利用专家功能共激活社区来进行基于聚类的局部低秩压缩，克服了单一共享组件在专家数增长时扩展性差的缺陷。它无需重训路由器，在较高压缩率下保持更好性能，并且通过树形组织（BTExperts）和重构微调进一步增强了实用性和推理效率。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models deliver high capacity at low per-token compute, but deploying them cheaply requires compressing their many expert weight matrices. Expert pruning (e.g., REAP) and merging reduce cost but sacrifice accuracy and require retraining the router; low-rank delta decomposition of experts (e.g., D^2-MoE) preserves all experts and the router, but degrades sharply as the expert count grows because a single shared component cannot approximate many near-orthogonal experts.
  Because MoE expert weights are near-orthogonal, a single shared component (as in prior delta decomposition) scales poorly with the expert count; we show that experts nonetheless organize into functional co-activation communities that are decoupled from weight similarity. Building on this, we introduce LorExperts, a router-preserving compression method that clusters experts, keeps one full-precision dominant per cluster, and represents the remaining members as low-rank corrections to their local dominant. LorExperts retains all experts and the original router (no router retraining). At ~50% expert compression on Qwen3-30B-A3B and Gemma-4-26B-A4B, LorExperts preserves downstream accuracy and perplexity better than the baselines on most of the tasks; the margin over D^2-MoE grows with expert count E. We further give a reconstruction fine-tuning procedure for LorExperts, and BTExperts, a tree organization of dominants and corrections that enables inference-time amortization of shared computation.

</details>


### [384] [From token probabilities to calibrated confidence: An empirical study of mathematical question answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07827)
*Avery Ma,Lorne Schell,Vin Bhaskara,Leila Pishdad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了大语言模型在数学问答任务中的置信度估计与校准问题。研究发现，虽然单个token概率往往过度自信，但对完整序列的词元概率进行聚合可以捕捉正确与错误生成之间的细微但一致的差异。多轮估计方法（包括自验证和蒙特卡洛Dropout）能够产生良好校准的置信度估计，而Platt缩放和等渗回归等后校准方法虽能显著降低域内校准误差，但其数据效率和跨数据集/模型的迁移性存在局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前人研究发现token概率往往过度自信，作者希望探究这些现成可用的信号能否为数学问答提供良好校准的置信度估计，并系统比较单轮与多轮估计方法的有效性及其校准表现。

Method: 比较了单轮估计器（重用原始生成的token概率）与多轮估计器（通过验证或随机前向传播获取额外置信信号）。多轮方法包括：通过重新提示的自验证（含低成本的in-situ变体）和蒙特卡洛Dropout。同时评估了Platt缩放和等渗回归两种后校准方法。

Result: 序列级token概率聚合能捕捉正确与错误生成间的小但一致的差异，比单个token概率更具信息量。多轮方法能产生校准的置信度估计。Platt缩放和等渗回归显著降低域内校准误差，但数据效率随数据集难度变化，且校准映射在跨数据集和模型间呈不对称迁移。

Conclusion: 虽然单轮估计的单个token概率存在过自信问题，但通过聚合和适当的校准方法可以获得可靠的置信度估计；不过校准方法在数据效率和可迁移性方面仍面临挑战。

Abstract: Confidence estimation for large language models (LLMs) aims to estimate the probability that a generated answer is correct, while calibration aligns these estimates with empirical accuracy. Prior work has shown that token probabilities are often overconfident, we investigate whether these readily available signals can nevertheless provide well-calibrated confidence estimation for mathematical question answering. We compare single-pass estimators, which reuse token probabilities from the original generation, with multi-pass estimators, which obtain additional confidence signals through verification or stochastic forward passes. While individual token probabilities can be highly saturated, we find that aggregating token probabilities over the full sequence captures small but consistent differences between correct and incorrect generations, yielding more informative confidence estimates. Multi-pass methods can yield calibrated confidence estimates. We study two such approaches: self-verification through re-prompting, including a lower-cost in-situ variant, and Monte Carlo Dropout, which derives confidence from variation across stochastic forward passes. We further evaluate two post-hoc calibration methods, Platt scaling and isotonic regression, both of which substantially reduce in-domain calibration error. However, their data efficiency varies with dataset difficulty, and the calibration mappings often transfer asymmetrically across datasets and models.

</details>


### [385] [TEMPER: Tensorized Efficient Manifold-constrained Parameterization for Expressive Residual Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07851)
*Yuxuan Gu,Wuyang Zhou,Huijun Xing,Danilo Mandic*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TEMPER方法，用张量网络将残差连接中的生成器参数化为结构化低秩张量，在保持流形约束的路由能力的同时大幅减少参数开销，在语言建模和常识推理任务上以更少的额外参数达到或超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有超连接（HC）和流形约束超连接（mHC）方法虽然增强了残差路由的表达力，但其生成器（用于分支前聚合、残差混合和分支后再分配）是密集且无结构的，导致参数数量随残差流数量快速增长，形成生成器层面的瓶颈。

Method: TEMPER将HC/mHC中的生成器表示为覆盖输入流、特征和输出流三个模态的多路张量，并使用张量网络（tensor networks）进行结构化低秩参数化。这种设计既能保持与令牌相关的流形约束路由接口，又能显著降低参数增长速度。张量秩控制学习的路由子空间维度，全秩可恢复稠密路由；生成器近似误差有界地约束路由logits及路由块输出的差异。

Result: 在语言建模和常识推理任务上，TEMPER匹配或优于现有方法。在8个残差流设置下，TEMPER取得最佳CORE分数，同时相比mHC减少约84%的额外参数，展现出更强的性能-参数效率权衡。

Conclusion: 张量网络参数化是解决残差路由生成器参数增长问题的有效手段，既保留了流形约束路由的表达力和稳定性，又大幅提升参数效率，同时提供了秩控制子空间维度和误差界等方面的可解释性。

Abstract: Residual connections rely on a static residual pathway, and are essential for training deep neural networks. Hyper-connections (HC) increase the expressivity of residual routing by incorporating multiple residual streams and learning dynamic information flow, while manifold-constrained (mHC) variants stabilize training through doubly stochastic residual mixing. However, a generator-level bottleneck remains in existing methods: they use dense, unstructured generators for pre-branch aggregation, residual mixing, and post-branch redistribution, which results in parameter count growing rapidly with the number of streams. To address this issue, we propose \underline{\textbf{T}}ensorized \underline{\textbf{E}}fficient \underline{\textbf{M}}anifold-constrained \underline{\textbf{P}}arameterization for \underline{\textbf{E}}xpressive Residual \underline{\textbf{R}}outing (\textbf{TEMPER}), which represents these generators as multi-way tensors over the input-stream, feature, and output-stream modes, and parameterizes them using tensor networks. Such a structured low-rank formulation is shown to preserve token-dependent manifold-constrained routing interface while substantially reducing parameter growth. It also promotes interpretability and intuition, as: i) tensor ranks control the dimensionality of the learned routing subspace, with full ranks recovering dense routing; while ii) the generator approximation errors bound differences in routing logits and, consequently, in the routed-block outputs. Comprehensive experiments show that TEMPER matches or outperforms existing methods across language modeling and commonsense reasoning tasks, while requiring substantially fewer additional parameters. At eight residual streams, TEMPER achieves the best CORE score while using about $84\%$ fewer additional parameters than mHC, thus showing a stronger performance-parameter efficiency trade-off.

</details>


### [386] [CommitKV: Lifecycle-Aware KV Cache Compression via Commit Transitions for Multi-Turn Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07855)
*Weizhong Huang,Jinchao Zhang,Xiawu Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CommitKV 提出了一种针对多轮 ReAct 智能体的 KV 缓存压缩方法，通过"提交转换"（commit transitions）识别 KV 的生命周期，区分暂时休眠的信息与已完成角色的信息，实现安全高效的缓存淘汰。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮 ReAct 智能体的推理轨迹不断累积，导致 KV 缓存增长，增加内存和注意力开销。现有基于注意力分数的快照式缓存压缩方法存在缺陷：当前轮次中低注意力并不意味着未来不相关，暂时休眠的信息可能在未来变得重要，而现有方法无法区分"暂时休眠"与"已完成角色"的信息。

Method: CommitKV 首先将已完成的智能体事件划分为 token 页，并在工具调用提交前后分别测量每个候选页的删除效果（成对测量）；基于这些配对测量，区分休眠页与高完成度候选页；然后应用贪心联合测试，仅在候选页合并后的提交后效果保持有界时才接受其退役；在后续压缩检查点，被接受的页面被排除，等待提交后测量的有界页面集被保护，其余 KV 状态在缓存预算内使用相同的 token 索引保留键、值和绝对位置。

Result: 在多个基准上的实验表明，CommitKV 降低了智能体的内存使用，加速了端到端推理，并相比现有 KV 缓存压缩方法取得了更高的准确率。

Conclusion: CommitKV 通过识别 KV 生命周期和提交转换机制，能够有效区分休眠信息与已完成角色的信息，实现既节省内存又保持性能的 KV 缓存压缩，为多轮推理智能体的高效部署提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Multi-turn Reasoning-and-Acting (ReAct) agents accumulate growing trajectories of reasoning, tool calls, and observations. Their key-value (KV) caches grow accordingly, increasing memory use and attention cost during model inference. Existing KV cache compression methods reduce these costs by evicting states with low attention scores. However, low attention in the current turn does not imply future irrelevance, as temporarily inactive information may become important later. Snapshot-based eviction methods therefore do not explicitly distinguish temporarily dormant information from information that appears to have completed its role. In this paper, we present CommitKV, which identifies KV lifecycles through commit transitions. Specifically, CommitKV first divides completed agent events into token pages and compares each eligible page's deletion effect before a tool-call commit and after the commit's returned observation has been incorporated. Based on these paired measurements, CommitKV distinguishes dormant pages from high-to-low completion candidates. It then applies a greedy joint test, accepting candidates for retirement only when their combined post-commit effect remains bounded. Finally, at a later compression checkpoint, accepted pages are excluded, a bounded set of pages awaiting post-commit measurement is protected, and the remaining KV states are retained within the cache budget using the same token indices for keys, values, and absolute positions. These mechanisms ensure that CommitKV can distinguish dormant information from information that has completed its observed role and can be safely removed. Experiments on various benchmarks show that CommitKV reduces agent memory use, accelerates end-to-end inference, and achieves higher accuracy than existing KV cache compression methods.

</details>


### [387] [Adaptive KappaSharp: Condition-Number Shaping for Preferential Bayesian Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07859)
*Ketong Shao,Jialu Wang,Xuekai Pei,Ali Mesbah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出KappaSharp方法，用于解决偏好贝叶斯优化（PBO）中PairwiseGP模型因比较图孤立分量导致的海森矩阵秩亏缺问题。KappaSharp通过对海森矩阵施加对角线修正来降低条件数，修正量与先验不确定性成正比，且仅在模型拟合阶段应用。自适应变体（Adaptive KappaSharp）仅在代理模型对近期比较有信心时才激活修正。在11个基准测试（5-20维）中，包括16维等离子体医学控制器调优问题，Adaptive KappaSharp相比标准PBO基线性能提升最高达+10.9%（p=0.003）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PBO标准方法（PairwiseGP + EUBO）中，每次查询产生的新配对与历史查询无共享候选，形成比较图中的孤立分量，导致似然海森矩阵秩亏缺。这种缺陷是结构性的，无法通过更换代理模型解决。现有缓解方法要么浪费查询预算强制保持连通性，要么使用均匀正则化扰动已有良好约束的方向。

Method: 提出KappaSharp方法，对海森矩阵施加对角线修正以降低条件数，其中修正量大小与先验不确定性成正比。该修正仅在模型拟合步骤中应用，不干扰查询选择过程。此外提出自适应变体，仅在代理对近期比较结果有信心时激活修正，避免在问题良态时进行不必要的修正。

Result: 在11个基准测试（5-20维），包括16维等离子体医学控制器调优问题中，Adaptive KappaSharp优于标准PBO基线，性能提升最高达+10.9%（p=0.003）。

Conclusion: KappaSharp通过针对性的对角线修正有效解决了PBO中海森矩阵秩亏缺的结构性问题，在保持查询效率的同时提升了优化性能，自适应变体进一步避免了不必要修正带来的潜在负面影响。

Abstract: Preferential Bayesian optimization (PBO) optimizes objectives accessible only through pairwise user comparisons. The standard approach fits a Gaussian process surrogate for observed pairwise comparisons (PairwiseGP) using the Laplace approximation and selects queries with the Expected Utility of Best Option (EUBO) acquisition function. EUBO queries new candidates at each step, producing pairs that share no candidates with previous queries. Each such pair forms an isolated component in the comparison graph, removing one degree of freedom from the likelihood Hessian and making it rank-deficient. This deficiency is structural and cannot be resolved by changing the surrogate modeling approach. Existing approaches to remedy this issue either waste query budget by forcing comparisons to stay connected, or apply uniform regularization that also perturbs directions already well-constrained by the observed comparisons. We propose KappaSharp that enables a diagonal correction to the Hessian to reduce its condition number, with larger corrections where the prior uncertainty is higher. The correction is only applied in the model fitting step, not query selection. An adaptive variant of KappaSharp is also presented that activates the correction only when the surrogate is confident about recent comparisons, avoiding unnecessary corrections when the problem is well-conditioned. On 11 benchmarks (5--20 dimensions), including a 16-dimensional controller tuning problem in plasma medicine, Adaptive KappaSharp outperforms the standard PBO baseline, with up to +10.9% ($p{=}0.003$).

</details>


### [388] [CONFER: Conflict-Aware Evidence Negotiation for Regime-Calibrated Weak Supervision in Multimodal Emotion Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07867)
*Bojing Hou,Ruohao Li,Yitong Zhu,Luwen Yu,Yuyang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CONFER是一个基于图的冲突感知证据协商框架，用于弱监督多模态情感识别。它通过将每个模态专家表示为节点，带有预测信念、边界不确定性和运行时可靠性，并利用不确定性感知的兼容性和可靠性导向的非对称边权重进行迭代消息传递协商。框架识别三种样本状态（共识、异议、歧义）用于样本级弱标签校准。在AMIGOS、MAHNOB-HCI和DEAP数据集上，严格LOSO协议下分别达到0.873和0.854的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态情感识别方法常将自我报告标签视为可靠监督，而忽视了自我报告不可靠性和跨模态冲突问题，缺乏对弱标签和模态间冲突的系统性处理机制。

Method: 将每个模态专家构建为图中的节点，赋予预测信念、边界不确定性及基于历史样本外表现和当前样本不确定性估计的运行时可靠性。通过不确定性感知兼容性和可靠性导向的非对称边权重驱动迭代消息传递协商，再进行同行支持预测读出。利用冲突减少、残差分歧和平均模态不确定性划分三种学习状态（共识、异议、歧义）进行样本级弱标签校准。

Result: 在AMIGOS、MAHNOB-HCI和DEAP上采用subject-dependent 10折和严格LOSO协议进行评估。CONFER在严格LOSO评估下于AMIGOS-V达到0.873准确率，MAHNOB-V达到0.854准确率，表现具有竞争力。分析显示高冲突样本上协商收益更大，对弱标签污染鲁棒性更强。

Conclusion: 跨模态冲突提供了有用信息，既能指导模态间的方向性协调，又能用于估计监督可靠性，验证了所提协商框架的有效性和鲁棒性。

Abstract: Multimodal emotion recognition often treats self-reported labels as reliable supervision while overlooking self-report unreliability and cross-modal conflict. We propose \textbf{CONFER}, a graph-based conflict-aware evidence negotiation framework for weakly supervised multimodal emotion recognition. CONFER represents each modality expert as a node with a predictive belief, boundary-based uncertainty, and runtime reliability estimated from historical out-of-fold performance and current-sample uncertainty. Uncertainty-aware compatibility and reliability-directed asymmetric edge weights govern iterative message-passing negotiation, followed by peer-supported prediction readout. Conflict reduction, residual disagreement, and mean modality uncertainty further characterize three regimes---Consensus, Dissent, and Ambiguity---for sample-specific weak-label calibration. We evaluate CONFER on AMIGOS, MAHNOB-HCI, and DEAP under subject-dependent 10-fold and strict leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) protocols. CONFER achieves competitive performance, reaching \textbf{0.873} accuracy on AMIGOS-V and \textbf{0.854} accuracy on MAHNOB-V under strict LOSO evaluation. Further analyses show larger negotiation gains on high-conflict samples and improved robustness to weak-label corruption, indicating that cross-modal conflict provides useful information for both directional modality coordination and supervision-reliability estimation.

</details>


### [389] [V-Simba: Unleashing the Architectural Potential of RL in Visual Continuous Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07870)
*Donghu Kim,Youngdo Lee,Hojoon Lee,Johan Obando-Ceron,Byungkun Lee,Aaron Courville,Pablo Samuel Castro,Jaegul Choo,Clare Lyle*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了V-Simba，一种受状态基RL中Simba架构启发的简单视觉RL架构，通过在SAC+数据增强基础上添加归一化层和点卷积，在多个基准上匹配或超越SOTA方法，同时比DrQ-v2计算效率更高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉RL中的样本效率仍然是一个核心挑战，高维输入掩盖了学习信号。虽然此前工作集中于算法解决方案（如更好的动力学模型或探索策略），但状态基RL的最新进展表明，仅架构设计就能带来显著的样本效率提升。这引出一个问题：这些架构原则能否迁移到视觉RL中？

Method: 引入V-Simba架构，基于SAC与数据增强构建，借鉴状态基RL中的Simba架构。具体修改包括：(1)添加归一化层以稳定训练；(2)使用点卷积（pointwise convolutions）以减少计算量。整体设计简单但有效。

Result: 在DMC、Adroit和Meta-World基准上，V-Simba匹配或超越了现有SOTA方法，同时在计算效率上优于DrQ-v2。

Conclusion: 证明了状态基RL中的架构设计原则可以成功迁移到视觉RL领域，仅通过架构修改（而非复杂算法）即可获得显著的样本效率提升，代码已开源。

Abstract: Improving sample efficiency remains a core challenge in reinforcement learning (RL), especially in real-world settings like robotics, where data collection is costly. This challenge is pronounced in visual RL, where high-dimensional inputs often obscure learning signals. While prior work in visual RL has focused on algorithmic solutions, such as better dynamics models or exploration strategies, recent advances in state-based RL show that architectural design alone can lead to significant gains in sample efficiency. This raises an important question: Can these architectural principles transfer to visual RL? In response, we introduce V-Simba, a simple yet effective visual RL architecture inspired by the Simba architecture from state-based RL. Built on top of Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) with data augmentation, V-Simba modifies the architecture by adding normalization layers to stabilize training and using pointwise convolutions to reduce computation. Despite its simplicity, V-Simba matches or outperforms the state-of-the-art methods across the DMC, Adroit, and Meta-World benchmarks, while being more computationally efficient than DrQ-v2. We make our code publicly available at https://github.com/DAVIAN-Robotics/V-Simba.

</details>


### [390] [Router Sensitivity Under Lightweight Fine-Tuning Identifies Prunable Experts in Mixture-of-Experts Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07890)
*Ali Janati,Kaoutar El Maghraoui,Xinyi Luo,Wenyuan Shen,Owen Zou,Yankai Mao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究如何使用轻量级参数高效微调（PEFT）来识别MoE模型中可剪枝的专家。作者发现仅用router-only LoRA微调（仅训练0.002%的参数）就能可靠地识别出可剪枝专家，其效果优于全模块LoRA。在Mixtral-8×7B-Instruct上，剪除一半专家后MMLU-Pro达到27.54%，比全模块LoRA高3个百分点。实验还发现IA3（冻结router权重）也能匹配直接router适应的效果，而无约束的加法适配器会退化信号。该方法在最大压缩下性能仍为基于幅度或随机剪枝的1.8倍，内存减少49%，延迟降低37%。该准则还能迁移到Qwen1.5-MoE数学微调场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE模型虽然解耦了总参数量与单token计算量，但部署时仍需存储所有专家，造成巨大内存开销。已有理论表明，在全量微调期间根据router范数变化剪枝专家可以保持精度，但全量微调成本高昂。本文旨在验证轻量级参数高效适配是否能恢复这一专家重要性信号，从而以低成本实现可扩展的专家剪枝。

Method: 方法包括：1) 使用参数高效适配器（如router-only LoRA）进行简短微调；2) 根据微调引发的router权重ℓ2范数变化对专家排序；3) 一次性剪除变化最小的专家。论文对比了不同适配器类型（LoRA、IA3、无约束加法适配器）以及不同适配范围（仅router、全模块）对信号质量的影响，并在多个MoE模型和任务上验证剪枝效果。

Result: 核心结果：1) router-only LoRA训练0.002%参数，剪除一半专家后在MMLU-Pro上达27.54%，优于全模块LoRA的24.42%；2) 精度随LoRA秩单调提升，最高达28.76%；3) IA3冻结router权重可匹配直接router适应，无约束加法适配器则退化信号；4) 性能准线性衰减而非崩溃，最大压缩下仍为幅度/随机剪枝的1.8倍；5) 内存减少49%，延迟降低37%；6) 25%压缩下与使用全激活统计的方法竞争力相当；7) Qwen1.5-MoE上剪除一半专家保留49.7%平均精度，随机剪枝跌至个位数。

Conclusion: router在轻量级微调下的敏感性使得有理论依据的专家剪枝在规模上变得可行。这一发现弥合了理论剪枝准则与实际部署成本之间的鸿沟，表明无需昂贵的全量微调即可获得可靠的专家重要性信号，为大规模MoE模型的高效部署提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models decouple total parameters from per-token compute, but deployment still requires storing every expert. Recent theory shows that pruning experts with the smallest router-norm changes during fine-tuning can preserve accuracy, but assumes full fine-tuning. We test whether lightweight adaptation can recover this signal. We briefly fine-tune with a parameter-efficient adapter, rank experts by the induced $\ell_2$ router change, and prune the least-changed experts in one shot. On Mixtral-8$\times$7B-Instruct (44.83% MMLU-Pro), router-only LoRA trains 0.002% of parameters and outperforms all-module LoRA at matched rank with half the experts removed (27.54% vs. 24.42%); signal quality declines as adaptation spreads to attention and expert weights. Accuracy improves monotonically with LoRA rank, reaching 28.76%. IA3, which leaves router weights frozen, matches direct router adaptation, whereas unconstrained additive adapters degrade the signal. Router-guided MMLU-Pro accuracy decays quasi-linearly rather than collapsing, remains nearly 1.8 times that of magnitude-based or random pruning at maximal compression, and reduces memory by 49% and per-token latency by 37%. At 25% compression, retention is competitive with methods using full activation statistics. The criterion also transfers to Qwen1.5-MoE fine-tuned for mathematics, retaining 49.7% mean accuracy over eleven benchmarks with half the experts removed while random pruning falls to single digits. Router sensitivity under lightweight fine-tuning therefore makes provably motivated expert pruning practical at scale.

</details>


### [391] [LLM-Based Embeddings for Program Analysis and Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07894)
*Calvin Higgins,Marco Alvarez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次将LLMCompiler（在IR代码上大规模预训练的LLM）产生的程序嵌入应用于程序分析和优化任务。通过将程序分成块、独立嵌入并聚合的方法，结合源代码和IR代码嵌入，在算法分类任务上实现了1.54%的错误率，比现有最优方法提升12%，并在异构设备映射任务上达到竞争力水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近年来机器学习尤其是大语言模型在程序分析和优化中展现出潜力，但目前缺乏针对IR代码的程序嵌入在典型分析与优化任务上的系统应用研究。作者希望探索预训练于IR代码的LLM所生成的嵌入是否能在程序分析任务中优于现有方法。

Method: 使用LLMCompiler（在IR代码上大规模预训练的LLM）生成程序嵌入。方法为：将程序拆分为多个块，分别用预训练LLM对每个块进行嵌入，然后将块级嵌入聚合成单个程序嵌入。实验同时利用源代码和IR代码的嵌入进行组合。

Result: 结合源代码和IR代码嵌入在算法分类任务上达到1.54%的错误率，相比当前最先进方法提升12%；在异构设备映射任务上取得具有竞争力的准确率。

Conclusion: 实验表明，训练一个性能感知的LLM用于嵌入IR代码，可能在代码优化任务中取得最先进的结果，为未来代码优化研究提供了新的方向。

Abstract: Recent advances have highlighted the potential of machine learning, particularly Large Language Models (LLMs), for analyzing and optimizing programs. We present the first application of program embeddings from LLMCompiler---an LLM massively pretrained on intermediate representation (IR) code---to representative program analysis and optimization tasks. We generate program embeddings directly from source and IR code using a simple approach: split programs into chunks, independently embed each chunk with pretrained LLMs, and then aggregate the chunk embeddings into a single program embedding. Our experiments show that combining source and IR code embeddings achieves an error rate of 1.54\% in algorithm classification, a 12\% improvement over the current state-of-the-art, and a competitive accuracy on heterogeneous device mapping. These findings suggest that training a performance-aware LLM for embedding IR code might yield state-of-the-art results in code optimization tasks.

</details>


### [392] [When Does Trace-Driven Evaluation Mislead MoE Expert Caching? Replay Semantics, Workload Contamination, and Operating Regimes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07911)
*Yu Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究MoE（混合专家）模型中的专家缓存管理策略评估问题，发现评估方法非常脆弱。通过跟踪驱动的事件原子模拟器（覆盖40/64/128个专家模型），作者识别出三个会改变结论（而非仅改变数字）的评估维度：重放语义、工作负载污染、运行体制。修正后，与离线最优的稳定差距保持在44.2-45.9%，其中84.3-96.6%可归因于对未来使用专家的先知知识。因果性下次使用预测器作为驱逐规则仅能恢复-11.4%的差距，表明大规模离线最优差距显著高估了代表性轻量因果机制可获得的收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE模型已超出加速器内存容量，将专家权重卸载到主机内存成为标准做法，这使得专家缓存管理成为重要优化手段。然而，评估缓存策略命中率提升效果是一个测量问题，且测量结果非常脆弱，需要系统性地识别和修正评估方法中的陷阱。

Method: 使用跟踪驱动、事件原子的模拟器，在三个MoE模型（40/64/128个专家）上隔离三个评估轴：1）重放语义（融合事件流量契约下的不一致逐访问重放会膨胀基于近因的策略）；2）工作负载污染（使用匹配对渲染干预修正探测集）；3）运行体制（跨模型不迁移的归一化缺失分数）。并通过强制接纳预言机分解离线最优差距，测试因果下次使用预测器作为驱逐规则。

Result: 不一致的逐访问重放使基于近因的策略膨胀27-29%，而频率型和静态型策略在4%以内，导致策略排名反转。匹配对渲染干预移动早期窗口效应19.4-31.9个点并反转工作负载友好性排序。仅重排事件流时间顺序使离线最优差距从44.9%变为30.8%。修正后稳定差距为44.2-45.9%；84.3-96.6%归因于未来使用专家知识；因果预测器仅恢复-11.4%差距，最优受害者选择率3.4%（对比随机2.4%、LRU/LFRU 20.6-22.1%）。

Conclusion: MoE专家缓存评估需同时报告单位步专家并集与每层容量比，且需遵守事件原子重放语义和匹配对工作负载设计。在本文评估设置下，大型离线最优差距大幅高估了代表性轻量因果机制能获得的实际收益，离线最优并非实用策略的良好代理指标。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have outgrown accelerator memory, and offloading expert weights to host memory is now standard. This makes expert cache management an attractive lever: a policy that raised the hit rate would cut expert traffic per token. Evaluating that is a measurement problem, and we find the measurement fragile.
  With a trace-driven, event-atomic simulator over three MoE models (40, 64, 128 experts), we isolate three evaluation axes that change conclusions, not just numbers. Replay semantics: under a fused-event traffic contract, an inconsistent per-access replay inflates recency-based policies by 27-29% while leaving frequency-based and static ones within 4%, inverting the policy ranking. Workload contamination: probe sets using one instruction template per category produce verbatim-identical generation prefixes; a matched-pair rendering intervention moves the measured early-window effect by 19.4-31.9 points and reverses which workloads look most cache-friendly. Operating regimes: normalized miss fractions do not transfer across models, so the per-step expert union relative to per-layer capacity must be reported -- yet permuting only the temporal order of an identical event stream moves the offline-optimal gap from 44.9% to 30.8%, so it is not sufficient.
  Corrected, a stable gap to the offline optimum remains (44.2-45.9% over 13 frozen workload compositions). A forced-admission oracle attributes 84.3-96.6% of it to knowing which resident expert is used furthest in the future. A causal next-use predictor, used as an eviction rule, recovers -11.4% of the gap; it picks an optimal victim 3.4% of the time, against 2.4% for a random resident block and 20.6-22.1% for LRU and LFRU. Our position is narrow: in our evaluated settings a large offline-optimal gap substantially overstates the gains recovered by representative lightweight causal mechanisms.

</details>


### [393] [SPECTRA: Pushing the KV Cache Beyond the 2-Bit Cliff via Spectral Transform Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07915)
*Jiamu Zhang,Liang Wu,Kelly Wan,Hanjie Chen,Liangjie Hong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SPECTRA是一种无需训练的KV缓存压缩编解码器，通过将缓存旋转到由自身统计信息计算得到的坐标系中，消除通道间相关性，从而将位预算集中在信息量最大的少数通道上，突破了2位量化的精度瓶颈，在长上下文场景下实现4倍近无损压缩、8倍竞争性压缩和最高12倍压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在智能体时代需要处理越来越长的输入，KV缓存随上下文长度增长并占用大量GPU显存。现有量化方法将每个值压缩到相同低精度，但在约2比特处遇到"2比特悬崖"——精度急剧下降，因为异常值主导的分布中少量大值消耗了所有量化级别，将其余值压缩成噪声。虽然按通道重要性分配不同位数是自然思路，但原始缓存中通道间强相关，没有通道显得更重要。

Method: 作者首先分析发现，将KV缓存旋转到由其自身统计信息计算出的坐标系中可以消除通道间相关性，此时少数通道承载几乎全部信息。基于此，SPECTRA构建一个无需训练的即插即用编解码器：将缓存重新编码到这个坐标系中，并将位预算集中分配到承载信号的通道上，实现非均匀的位分配。

Result: 在Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen2.5-7B上，经过长上下文基准测试，SPECTRA在4倍压缩时接近无损，在8倍压缩时仍具竞争力（此时均匀量化已崩溃），最高可达12倍压缩，突破了2比特悬崖，使相同GPU可以处理更长的上下文和更大的批次。

Conclusion: 通过旋转坐标系来去相关化KV缓存通道，可以暴露出通道重要性的差异，从而让位预算分配更高效。SPECTRA成功将可用压缩比推过2比特量化的极限，为长上下文推理提供了更高效的显存利用方案。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly read long inputs in the agentic era, from whole documents and codebases to conversations across many turns. Their inference memory is then dominated by the key-value (KV) cache, the stored attention keys and values of every token the model has read and generated. Because the cache grows with context length and is re-read in full at every generated token, a longer context means more GPU memory.
  To reduce this cost, most existing methods compress the KV cache by lowering every stored value to the same low precision, a technique known as quantization. They can push this to nearly two bits per value, but rarely further, because quality drops sharply at this 2-bit cliff: four levels are too few for the cache's outlier-heavy values, where a few large entries consume the levels and collapse the rest into noise. A natural remedy is to spend more bits on the channels (feature dimensions) that matter and fewer on the rest, but the raw cache offers no handle: its channels are strongly correlated, so none stands out as more important.
  Our analysis shows that this handle appears once the cache is rotated into a coordinate system computed from its own statistics, removing these correlations. There, a small fraction of channels carries almost all the information, and spending the budget on those few is far more accurate than spreading it evenly.
  Guided by this analysis, we develop SPECTRA, a training-free, drop-in codec that re-encodes the cache into this coordinate system and concentrates the bit budget on the channels that carry the signal. On Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B over long-context benchmarks, SPECTRA is near-lossless at 4x compression, competitive at 8x where uniform quantization has collapsed, and reaches up to 12x, pushing usable compression past the 2-bit cliff so the same GPU holds longer contexts and larger batches.

</details>


### [394] [Spectral Outliers Reveal Dominant Learned Structure in Transformer Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07921)
*Kasun Dewage,Marianna Pensky,Suranadi De Silva,T. H. Bandara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文运用Marchenko-Pastur随机矩阵理论将预训练注意力权重分解为随机性bulk和光谱离群值（信号）两部分，并通过因果实验验证该分解的有效性：在Mistral-7B中置零MP识别的离群值可致性能接近随机水平，而置零同等数量的bulk奇异值仅造成较小退化。研究跨11个预训练Transformer识别出五种反复出现的结构模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练注意力权重中哪些成分承载了真正的学习结构（信号），哪些仅是随机噪声成分？以往缺乏系统性的方法来区分二者，也缺乏因果验证。理解这种信号/噪声分离对于参数高效微调和结构化剪枝具有重要意义。

Method: 将Marchenko-Pastur随机矩阵理论应用于预训练注意力权重，将每个投影矩阵分解为随机-like bulk和光谱离群值两部分；通过因果干预实验（分别置零离群值和bulk奇异值）验证分解的有效性；并在11个预训练Transformer上进行跨模型模式归纳。

Result: 1) 在Mistral-7B上，置零MP识别的离群值导致HellaSwag、MMLU和PIQA接近随机水平；2) 置零同等数量的bulk奇异值仅造成较小但不可忽略的性能退化；3) 识别出五种跨模型模式：光谱离群值编码主要学习结构、Q投影携带最多离群值、GQA下的V投影缺乏清晰信噪分离、Q和O投影中的条目级离群值分别形成行带和列带、K和O投影中特定残差流维度跨层形成持续带离群值。

Conclusion: MP随机矩阵理论为预训练注意力权重提供了一种有效的信号/噪声分解工具，且该分解具有因果有效性。离群值确实承载了模型的核心学习结构。这些发现为参数高效微调和结构化剪枝提供了理论依据和实用指导。

Abstract: We apply Marchenko-Pastur (MP) random matrix theory to pre-trained attention weights in order to separate each projection matrix into a random-like bulk and a set of spectral outliers. We validate this decomposition causally: zeroing the MP-identified outliers (signal) in Mistral-7B drives HellaSwag, MMLU, and PIQA close to random-chance performance, whereas zeroing a count-matched subset of bulk singular values causes smaller but non-negligible degradation. Across 11 pre-trained transformers we identify five recurring patterns: spectral outliers encode a dominant component of the learned structure; Q projections carry the most outliers; V projections under grouped-query attention lack a clean signal/noise separation; entry-level outliers form structured row-bands in Q and column-bands in O; and specific residual-stream dimensions persist as band outliers across layers in K and O. We close by outlining how these observations could inform parameter-efficient fine-tuning and structured pruning.

</details>


### [395] [Information Routing across Batch Boundaries: Memory--Batch Tradeoffs in Lipschitz Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07922)
*Zicheng Lyu,Zengfeng Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究随机Lipschitz bandits中自适应学习的宽度-深度权衡：学习者在每次拉臂后仅保留至多W比特的奖励相关状态，并将拉臂组织为至多B个承诺批次。论文刻画了W≥log(eT)情形下极小极大期望伪遗憾（至多差对数因子），发现新的惩罚项T^((d+2)/(d+3))·(1+(B-1)W)^(-1/(d(d+3)))，证明状态宽度与更新深度不可互换，并给出了匹配的策略与下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应学习既需要保留观测信息的状态，也需要在该状态上采取行动的机会，这两者之间存在本质的tradeoff。然而此前对随机Lipschitz bandits的研究未系统地刻画状态记忆宽度（W比特）与批次承诺深度（B批次）之间的相互作用，特别是二者是否可互换这一核心问题悬而未决。

Method: 论文从信息路由约束的角度建立分析框架：在区域尺度s上，低遗憾要求承诺的动作转录编码Θ_d(s^{-d})个区域决策，而收集的边界状态至多携带(B-1)W比特熵。据此推导匹配的策略——流式生成并擦除验证统计量，同时保留安全活动集的掩码（可存于内存或分片存储）——并建立对每个W均成立的下界。

Result: 对W≳d·log(eT)，刻画了极小极大期望伪遗憾（至多差对数因子）；下界对所有W成立。揭示了新的惩罚项T^((d+2)/(d+3))(1+(B-1)W)^(-1/(d(d+3)))，表明状态宽度与更新深度不可互换。定理还恢复了全维度最坏情形纯批次前沿，并在完全顺序特例中恢复了对数内存可达性；静态批次边界与可预测自适应边界等价。

Conclusion: 状态宽度（保留多少信息）与更新深度（多久更新一次决策）在随机Lipschitz bandits中不可互换，二者的相互作用由一种信息路由约束所支配。该结果为自适应学习中的记忆-行动权衡提供了精确的极小极大刻画，并为设计内存受限、批次受限的在线学习算法提供了理论指导。

Abstract: Adaptive learning needs both a state that preserves what observations imply and opportunities to act on that state. We study this width--depth tradeoff in stochastic Lipschitz bandits. After each pull, the learner retains at most $W$ bits of live reward-dependent state and organizes its pulls into at most $B$ committed batches. For $W\gtrsim_d\log(eT)$, we characterize minimax expected pseudo-regret up to logarithmic factors; the lower bounds hold for every $W$. Besides the classical sequential and unrestricted-memory batch costs, the frontier contains the new penalty \[
  T^{\frac{d+2}{d+3}}
  \bigl(1+(B-1)W\bigr)^{-\frac1{d(d+3)}}, \] proving that state width and update depth are not interchangeable. The interaction is an information-routing constraint: at regional scale $s$, low regret forces the committed action transcript to encode $Θ_d(s^{-d})$ regional decisions, while the collected boundary states carry at most $(B-1)W$ bits of entropy. Matching policies stream and erase verification statistics while retaining a mask of a safe active set, either in memory or fragment by fragment. The theorem recovers the full-dimensional worst-case batch-only frontier and logarithmic-memory achievability in the fully sequential specialization; static batch boundaries match predictable adaptive ones.

</details>


### [396] [Second Order Drifting Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07924)
*Drake Brown,Yuhao Huang,Shih-Hsin Wang,Bao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出二阶漂移模型（Second-Order Drifting Models），通过将生成样本增强人工速度变量、将漂移动力学提升到相空间，使密度扰动在傅里叶空间中服从加速的二阶动力学，从而缓解一阶漂移模型在细粒度结构恢复上的谱刚性（spectral stiffness）问题，同时保持单步推理的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一阶漂移模型虽然避免了迭代推理，但其基于核函数的漂移场在训练中产生频率依赖的动力学：在线性化机制下，密度残差的每个傅里叶模式以由核谱决定的速率衰减，导致细粒度结构的恢复缓慢（即谱刚性）。这限制了模型对高频细节的建模能力。

Method: 将漂移动力学从原始空间提升到相空间，即为生成的样本引入人工速度变量，使得密度扰动在傅里叶空间中服从加速的二阶动力学。这一机制与优化理论中的Nesterov加速方法建立了联系。作者还推导了实用的半隐式训练算法。

Result: 在合成分布匹配、序列数据生成和机器人控制等多个场景中进行了评估，二阶漂移模型改善了收敛行为，并在性能上达到或优于一阶漂移基线。

Conclusion: 二阶漂移模型通过相空间提升和加速动力学提供了一种缓解一阶漂移谱刚性的原理性机制，在保持单步推理的同时提升了收敛性和生成质量，拓展了漂移模型家族的能力边界。

Abstract: Drifting models are a recent class of one-step generative models that evolve the model distribution during training using a predefined sample-based drift field. Although they avoid iterative inference, their kernel-based drift fields induce frequency-dependent training dynamics: In the linearized regime, each Fourier mode of the density residual decays at a rate determined by the kernel spectrum, leading to slow recovery of fine-scale structure. We propose Second-Order Drifting Models, which lift drifting dynamics into phase space by augmenting generated samples with artificial velocity variables. We show that the resulting density perturbations obey accelerated second-order dynamics in Fourier space, connecting drifting models to the celebrated Nesterov acceleration from optimization theory. This provides a principled mechanism for mitigating the spectral stiffness of first-order drifting while preserving one-step inference. We derive a practical semi-implicit training algorithm and evaluate it on synthetic distribution matching, sequential data generation, and robotic control. Across these settings, the second-order drifting model improves convergence behavior and achieves competitive or superior performance over first-order drifting baselines.

</details>


### [397] [Multi-Agent AI Safety as an Institutional Design Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09828)
*Abdullah X*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文是POLIS研究项目的第一篇论文，通过5,280个冻结剧集的研究套件，系统探究AI机构中哪些部分产生安全性及其作用机制。研究发现，宪法提示和可溯源执行守卫都能实现0/384的违规率，但两者机制截然不同；局部状态守卫在权限洗白场景中存在显著漏洞；机构规则的表述、系统信任的权威状态以及被阻止后的替代路径共同决定安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究表明AI代理的部署规则可以改变集体行为，但尚不清楚AI机构中的哪些具体组成部分（规则本身、权威状态、执行机制、事后路径等）真正产生安全效果，以及它们各自的运作机制是什么。作者希望系统性地拆解AI机构的安全来源。

Method: 构建冻结的5,280集研究套件，包含预指定的委托实验（覆盖4个模型家族）和高冲突诊断实验（增加3个模型端点）。在匹配的结构化工作流中，操控规则表述形式、守卫咨询的权威状态、即时合规回退的吸引力以及允许被阻止工作流继续等变量。同时进行资源分配实验，揭示披露配额数值的影响。

Result: 详细宪法提示实现0/384实际违规；可溯源执行守卫也实现0/384违规（阻止51/384尝试，其中44/51后续安全完成）；局部状态守卫的失败集中在"普通变换改变可见政策但原始权威不变"的场景。在权限洗白场景中，局部状态守卫在22/96剧集允许违规，而溯源执行为0/96（p=4.77x10^-7）。资源实验中，披露相同上限的数值会改变代理请求行为。

Conclusion: 相同的最终违规率可能掩盖截然不同的安全机制。规则本身只是机构的一部分；系统信任的权威状态至关重要，被阻止后可用路径同样关键。AI机构的安全性设计需要综合考虑规则表述、权威追踪和阻断后的补救路径。

Abstract: AI agents increasingly work inside systems that govern how they delegate tasks, move information, execute actions, and use shared resources. Recent work already shows that deployment rules can change collective behavior. Here we ask which parts of an AI institution produce safety and how they do it. This is the first paper from POLIS, an ongoing research programme studying algorithmic institutions for multi-agent systems. We report a frozen 5,280-episode study suite. The main pre-specified delegation experiment spans four model families; a targeted high-conflict diagnostic adds three additional model endpoints. In matched structured workflows, the model sees different rule formulations and guards consult different authority states. We also vary the attractiveness of the immediate compliant internal/self fallback and allow blocked workflows to continue. A detailed constitutional prompt produces 0/384 realized violations. A provenance-aware executable guard also produces 0/384, although it blocks prohibited attempts in 51/384 episodes; 44/51 of those episodes later complete safely. The local-state guard's failures concentrate in scenarios where an ordinary transformation changes visible policy while originating authority stays fixed. In matched laundering scenarios, that guard admits violations in 22/96 episodes and provenance enforcement in 0/96 (p = 4.77 x 10^-7). A separate resource-allocation experiment shows that revealing the numerical value of an otherwise identical cap changes agent requests. In these structured workflows, the same final violation rate can hide very different mechanisms. The rule itself is only part of the institution. The authority state the system trusts matters, and so does the path available after a block.

</details>


### [398] [Adaptive Supervised Anchoring for On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07935)
*Meilin Yang,Zixuan Ding,Jianhao Nie,Weite Zhang,Yuxin Zhang,Zhiming Shao,Li Yu,Zhe Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种统一的训练框架，将基于rollout的条件分布匹配与基于规范上下文（canonical contexts）的交叉熵监督分离，以解决on-policy self-distillation中因学生轨迹漂移导致的信号退化问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPSD的效果严重依赖学生采样的轨迹质量，当学生rollout偏离目标轨迹时，教师在这类off-target前缀上的条件监督会显著弱化，作者称之为"rollout-conditioned signal degradation"，这是当前OPSD方法的核心瓶颈。

Method: 提出分离两条互补的监督路径：1）保留rollout条件分布匹配，为学生实际访问的状态提供引导；2）在规范的ground-truth上下文上应用监督交叉熵，避免在错误rollout前缀上强加目标token。通过token级rollout-target对齐自适应调整规范上下文锚点的强度，冷启动时加强、rollout质量提升后放松。

Result: 在多种模型规模、两类任务族和通用推理基准上，所提方法相比OPSD提升了任务习得能力，同时保持通用能力，实现了更优的经验可塑性-稳定性（plasticity-stability）权衡。

Conclusion: 上下文质量是on-policy self-distillation的核心瓶颈，将rollout条件引导与规范监督分离是有效的解决方案。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) adapts a language model by distilling guidance from a frozen teacher on trajectories sampled from the student. Its effectiveness, however, depends critically on the quality of those trajectories. We show that when student rollouts drift from target trajectories, conditioning the teacher on off-target prefixes substantially weakens its task-relevant supervision. Controlled prefix-corruption experiments expose this failure mode, which we term rollout-conditioned signal degradation. To address this problem, we propose a unified training framework that separates two complementary supervision pathways. The first retains rollout-conditioned distribution matching, providing guidance on states the student actually visits. The second applies supervised cross-entropy on canonical ground-truth contexts, avoiding the incompatibility of imposing target tokens on erroneous rollout prefixes. Token-level rollout-target alignment is used to adapt the strength of the canonical-context anchor, emphasizing it during cold start and relaxing it as rollout quality improves. Experiments across multiple model scales, two task families, and general-reasoning benchmarks show that the proposed approach improves task acquisition over OPSD while preserving general capabilities, resulting in a more favorable empirical plasticity-stability trade-off. These findings identify context quality as a central bottleneck in on-policy self-distillation and demonstrate the value of separating rollout-conditioned guidance from canonical supervision.

</details>


### [399] [Persistent Semantic Entities in Tool-Augmented LLM Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07952)
*Zhaohui Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文形式化定义了"持久语义实体"(PSEs)——工具增强型LLM智能体中跨会话、跨边界存续的隐式状态，并在24个模型上系统评估了其易感性、持久性和检测方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具增强型LLM智能体可携带跨会话存续、通过事件触发并在智能体边界间传播的隐式状态，这些状态对标准调试手段基本不可见，构成严重安全隐患。

Method: 通过名称绑定、事件触发和跨边界传播三个机制形式化定义PSEs，在11个模型家族共24个模型（1.5B-1T参数）上评估，并测试上下文隔离的自验证检测方法。

Result: 所有测试模型均易受污染（20-100%）；偏好污染在所有模型上100%持留，指令污染持留且无自我纠正，人设注入部分衰减（90%→10%），事实注入因模型而异；自验证方法可实现20-79%（中位36.5%）的污染减少，流水线中污染复合增长1.9倍。

Conclusion: 偏好和指令污染具有持久性、缺乏自我纠正且难以被标准监控捕获，是部署智能体系统中最值得关注的攻击面。

Abstract: Tool-augmented LLM agents can harbor implicit state that persists across sessions, activates through events, and propagates across agent boundaries---largely invisible to standard debugging. We formalize this as Persistent Semantic Entities (PSEs): constructs defined by name binding, event triggering, and cross-boundary propagation, and evaluate them across 24 models from 11 families (1.5B--1T parameters). First, every tested model is susceptible (20--100% on the 20-model susceptibility panel), with name binding as the necessary and dominant mechanism: without it, contamination is 0%.
