Conclusion: 当前生成式时间序列模型的评估方法在零膨胀数据上存在系统性缺陷，标准协议可能产生误导性结论。研究者需要重新审视评估窗口的设计、选择恰当的occurrence统计量，并对模型在离散/零膨胀数据上的表现给予更多关注。

Abstract: Many of the series that generative time-series models are benchmarked on place a large probability mass on a single value --- it does not rain, no ride is requested, no part is ordered. We report what happens when such data is evaluated carefully. First, the standard rolling-origin protocol can score a model on a window whose atom structure bears no resemblance to the dataset: on one benchmark the dataset is $42\%$ zeros and the evaluation windows are $13\%$, on another $47\%$ against $5\%$. This is not a cosmetic problem --- it reversed one of our own conclusions, turning the strongest occurrence model in our study into what looked like a cautionary tale. Second, we give a control in which CRPS is invariant \emph{by construction} while the temporal coupling is destroyed, which measures exactly how much that coupling contributes to a chosen statistic. Third, benchmarking seven models on a matched protocol over five seeds, an autoregressive hurdle beats a conditional flow on five of six datasets, by up to a factor of $153$, while the flow's own occurrence statistics vary by up to $62\%$ across training seeds and every baseline is deterministic. Finally, the model ordering is not the same under five different occurrence statistics, and the two that do not share a construction agree with each other least.

</details>


### [536] [PET/CT Radiogenomic Mutation Prediction in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Using Multi-Label Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09721)
*Mona Furukawa,Sai Hyne,Daniel R. McGowan,Bartłomiej W. Papież*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究首次系统性地探讨了基于PET/CT影像组学的多标签深度学习在非小细胞肺癌EGFR、TP53和KRAS基因突变预测中的应用，并在英国新型影像基因组学队列上验证了成对多标签学习的效果。结果表明多标签学习的有效性取决于具体的基因突变组合，KRAS/TP53联合预测效果最佳，提示应根据突变组合采用特异的建模策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肺癌是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一，靶向治疗虽改善了非小细胞肺癌患者的预后，但依赖组织活检进行突变谱分析，属于有创操作且存在多种局限。因此需要探索无创的影像基因组学方法，通过PET/CT深度学习预测基因突变状态，以替代或补充传统的组织活检。

Method: 采用基于PET/CT的影像基因组学方法，使用深度学习模型预测EGFR、TP53和KRAS基因突变；并将传统的单基因分类框架扩展为成对多标签学习（pairwise multi-label learning），系统比较两种策略在突变预测中的表现。实验在一个新型英国影像基因组学队列上进行。

Result: KRAS和TP53的联合预测将KRAS的AUC从0.58提升至0.64，TP53的AUC从0.69提升至0.71；对于EGFR/KRAS组合，仅EGFR从联合学习中获益；而EGFR/TP53组合未观察到改善。

Conclusion: 多标签学习的有效性取决于所建模的特定基因突变组合，并非所有组合都能从中获益。这提示在PET/CT影像基因组学预测中，应采用突变特异性（mutation-specific）的建模策略，而非一刀切地使用多标签学习。

Abstract: Lung cancer remains one of the leading causes of cancer- related mortality worldwide. Although targeted therapies have improved outcomes for patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), they rely on mutation profiling through tissue biopsy, an invasive procedure with several limitations. This study investigates PET/CT-based radio- genomic prediction of epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR), tumour protein 53 (TP53), and Kirsten rat sarcoma viral oncogene (KRAS) mutations using deep learning. We further evaluate whether pairwise multi-label learning improves mutation prediction compared with conventional single-gene classification. To the best of our knowledge, this is among the first studies to systematically investigate multi-label learning for PET/CT radiogenomic mutation prediction in NSCLC. Experiments were conducted on a novel UK-based radiogenomics cohort. Joint pre- diction of KRAS and TP53 improved AUC from 0.58 to 0.64 for KRAS and from 0.69 to 0.71 for TP53. For the EGFR/KRAS pair, only EGFR benefited from joint learning, while no improvement was observed for the EGFR/TP53 pair. These findings demonstrate that the effectiveness of multi-label learning depends on the specific combination of gene mutations being modelled, suggesting that mutation-specific modelling strategies may be preferable for PET/CT radiogenomic prediction.

</details>


### [537] [Rethinking Factor Sharing in Federated LoRA: A Rank-Aware Adaptive Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09742)
*Xinyi Xu,Bingnan Xiao,Shuang Qin,Gang Feng,Tony Q. S. Quek*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FedAS-LoRA，一种联邦学习中自适应选择LoRA因子共享策略的方法。通过理论分析揭示Share-A/Local-B与Share-B/Local-A两种策略会导致不同的投影残差，并提出RSS指标在训练前评估共享子空间的充分性，从而选择最优的共享策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA因子A和B在联邦微调中扮演不对称角色，现有方法未深入探究应该共享哪个因子。不同客户端数据分布不同，盲目选择共享策略会影响微调性能，需要一种自适应的方法来选择合适的因子共享方案。

Method: 1) 通过最小二乘代理模型理论分析两种共享策略的投影残差差异；2) 提出RSS（Rank-Aware Shared-Subspace Sufficiency）指标，利用冻结LLM骨干提取的表示来评估共享rank-r子空间对本地数据分布的充分性；3) 在训练前基于RSS自适应选择共享因子（A或B）的策略。

Result: 在多种任务、数据分布、LoRA秩和参与率设置下的实验验证了RSS指标的有效性，并展示了FedAS-LoRA相比现有方法具有更优的微调性能。

Conclusion: LoRA因子的共享策略选择应基于客户端数据分布的特征，通过训练前的自适应选择可以显著提升联邦微调性能。RSS指标为这一选择提供了可靠的依据。

Abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) represents large language model (LLM) updates with two compact matrix factors, i.e., $A$ and $B$, providing an efficient way to fine-tune large models in federated learning paradigm. Inspired by the asymmetric roles of the LoRA factors, we study whether $A$ should be shared across clients while $B$ remains client-specific (Share-A/Local-B), or whether $B$ should instead be shared while $A$ remains client-specific (Share-B/Local-A). With a least-squares surrogate, we reveal that Share-A/Local-B requires the client-specific LoRA update matrices to use a common rank-$r$ input-side space, whereas Share-B/Local-A requires a common rank-$r$ output-side space. The two strategies therefore incur different projection residuals, indicating that the preferred strategy is the one with the smaller aggregate residual across clients. With this insight, we propose Federated Adaptive Factor Sharing Low-Rank Adaptation (FedAS-LoRA), which selects the sharing side before training to enhance fine-tuning performance. To enable adaptive factor selection before training, we design a Rank-Aware Shared-Subspace Sufficiency (RSS) metric, which effectively assesses whether a shared rank-$r$ input subspace is sufficient for the local data distributions using representations extracted from a frozen LLM backbone. Experiments across different tasks, data distributions, LoRA ranks, and participation settings confirm the effectiveness of RSS and the superior performance of FedAS-LoRA.

</details>


### [538] [SR-OPSD: Self-Referenced On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09745)
*Zhuo Sun,Entong Li,Yanlong Zhao,Xiaoyuan Cheng,Wenxuan Yuan,Kaiyu Li,Che Liu,Huihang Liu,Harrison Bo Hua Zhu,Li Zeng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出自参照在线自蒸馏（SR-OPSD）方法，解决在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）中自教师策略与学生策略协同演化导致的不稳定优化问题。通过token级变分表征将蒸馏目标分解为自教师策略与参考策略的几何插值，并用Rényi散度族泛化投影几何，在科学评估、数学推理和代码生成任务上达到最先进或竞争性性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPSD利用稠密token级监督作为稀疏奖励强化学习的补充，但其自教师策略与学生策略及上下文分布共同演化，直接匹配这种移动目标会导致优化不稳定或分布过度集中。

Method: SR-OPSD包含两个关键设计：(1) 在固定的学生生成上下文下，通过token级变分表征将有效蒸馏目标确定为自教师策略与参考策略之间的几何插值，插值系数控制底层目标位置；(2) 使用Rényi散度族泛化投影几何，Rényi阶数控制投影几何及其对token级密度比的敏感性，从而将"目标放置在哪里"与"学生如何投影"分离。

Result: 在科学评估、数学推理和代码生成任务上，结合多个大型语言模型的广泛实验表明，SR-OPSD在各种设置下实现了最先进或具有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: SR-OPSD通过解耦自适应目标的位置与投影几何，有效缓解了OPSD中移动目标带来的不稳定问题，为在线自蒸馏提供了更稳健的优化框架。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) converts feedback into dense token-level supervision on trajectories generated by the policy to be optimized, providing a useful complement to reinforcement learning with sparse outcome rewards. However, the self-teacher policy used in OPSD is typically a stop-gradient or exponential-moving-average copy of the policy conditioned on additional context information, and thus co-evolves with both the student policy and its on-policy context distribution. Directly matching such a moving target with a fixed projection objective can lead to unstable optimization or excessive distributional concentration. This nature of OPSD motivates the proposed \emph{Self-Referenced On-Policy Self-Distillation (SR-OPSD)}. At fixed student-generated contexts, a token-level variational characterization identifies the effective distillation target as a geometric interpolation between the self-teacher policy and a reference policy. Meanwhile, we use the Rényi divergence family to generalize the projection geometry. This formulation separates \emph{where} the adaptive target is placed from \emph{how} the student is projected toward it: the interpolation coefficient controls underlying target, while the Rényi order controls the projection geometry and its sensitivity to token-level density ratios. Extensive experiments across scientific evaluation, mathematical reasoning, and coding generation tasks with multiple large language models show that SR-OPSD achieves the state-of-the-art or competitive performance across various settings.

</details>


### [539] [MoNo: Multiscale Optimal Transport Neural Operator for Solving PDEs on General Geometries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09764)
*Zijiang Yang,Xiaomeng Wu,Dongmei Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了MoNo（多尺度最优传输神经算子），通过CoTAP（跨尺度最优传输分配与投影）机制解决现有Transformer类神经算子中潜在token分配不平衡的问题，在通用几何上实现稳定的多尺度潜空间构建，从而提升PDE求解的预测性能和计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于Transformer的神经算子在学习物理交互时，其可学习的投影机制无法保证观测点到潜空间token的稳定、平衡分配，导致部分token被过度分配而其他token利用不足。这种分配不平衡在多尺度层次架构中会被不断继承和放大，最终导致深层潜空间中的token坍缩，限制了多尺度架构的设计。

Method: 提出MoNo框架，核心组件为CoTAP，将相邻潜空间之间的跨空间分配建模为带熵正则化的最优传输问题，构建平衡的双向投影和稳定的潜空间；通过CoTAP确保跨多个潜空间的稳定信息传递，从而在通用几何上支持多尺度架构，高效学习长程物理交互。

Result: 大量实验表明MoNo在预测性能和计算效率两方面均超越了现有的最先进神经算子方法，代码已开源。

Conclusion: 通过将最优传输理论引入潜空间构建，MoNo有效解决了token分配不平衡和深层坍缩问题，验证了多尺度潜空间架构在PDE求解中的可行性，为通用几何上的PDE求解提供了新的高效方案。

Abstract: Transformer-based neural operators have achieved substantial progress in solving Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) by projecting spatial observations into compact latent tokens and learning physical interactions in latent spaces. However, we reveal that existing learnable projection mechanisms cannot ensure stable and balanced assignments from observation points to latent tokens, causing some latent tokens to be over-assigned while others remain underutilized. This limitation further restricts the design of hierarchical architectures, as assignment imbalance is continuously inherited and amplified across latent spaces, eventually causing severe token collapse in deeper spaces. To address these issues, we propose MoNo (Multiscale Optimal Transport Neural Operator), a progressive multiscale neural operator that efficiently solves PDEs on general geometries through stable latent-space construction. At its core is CoTAP (Cross-scale Optimal Transport Assignment and Projection), a novel latent-space construction method that formulates cross-space assignment between adjacent spaces as an entropy-regularized optimal transport problem, thereby constructing balanced bidirectional projections and stable latent spaces. CoTAP also ensures stable information transfer across multiple latent spaces, further enabling multiscale architectures on general geometries, which in turn support more efficient learning of long-range physical interactions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MoNo outperforms existing state-of-the-art neural operators in both prediction performance and computational efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/ZijiangY1116/MoNo.

</details>


### [540] [ReliableNet: A Chance-Constrained Approach to Trustworthy Classification in Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09768)
*Ange-Clément Akazan,Ineza Remy Mugenga,Abebe Geletu,Jean Medard Ngnotchouye,Issa Karambal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ReliableNet，一种通过机会约束ERM直接约束"自信但错误"（JCW）联合风险概率的分类方法，在分布内和多种分布偏移下均优于现有基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自信但错误的预测是严重可靠性失败，因为它恰好能绕过弃权和人工审查。现有方法（校准、不确定性估计、共形风险控制、选择性预测）仅针对相关可靠性属性，并未在训练过程中直接约束这一联合失败事件。

Method: 将JCW概率约束建模为机会约束ERM问题，采用保守光滑内逼近，其总体可行性蕴含原始JCW约束的满足。

Result: 在四个表格数据集和两个图像数据集上，ReliableNet是唯一在分布内所有数据集和所有随机种子下均被认证满足JCW预算的方法；在人口统计、歧义、虚假相关、新类别和协变量偏移下，其经验JCW最低，同时精度、覆盖率、校准和选择性预测均具有竞争力。

Conclusion: ReliableNet为可信分类提供了原则性的方法框架，能够在训练阶段直接约束JCW风险，兼顾可靠性与性能。

Abstract: A prediction that is both confident and wrong is a critical reliability failure because it can bypass abstention and human review precisely when the model is mistaken. Empirical risk minimization (ERM) controls average loss but not this failure directly, while calibration, uncertainty estimation, conformal risk control, and selective prediction methods target related reliability properties rather than bounding the joint failure event during training. We propose ReliableNet, which constrains the Joint Confident-Wrong (JCW) probability, the probability that a prediction is simultaneously confident and incorrect, below a user-specified risk budget $α\in(0,1)$. We formulate this as a chance-constrained ERM problem, use a conservative smooth inner approximation whose population feasibility implies the original JCW constraint. Across four tabular and two image datasets, ReliableNet is the only method certified within the JCW budget for every dataset and seed in distribution, when compared against baselines spanning ERM, post-hoc calibration, conformal risk control, and selective prediction. Under demographic, ambiguity, spurious-correlation, novel-class, and covariate shifts, it achieves the lowest empirical JCW among the compared methods while remaining very competitive in accuracy, coverage, calibration, and selective prediction. Risk-coverage results further indicate that ReliableNet achieves better selective ranking than the benchmark methods on most datasets. Overall, ReliableNet provides a principled approach to trustworthy classification.

</details>


### [541] [Distill Skills into Weights, Not Prompts: Abstract Skills as Privileged Signals for On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09826)
*Yubo Jiang,Fengying Xie,Zhiguo Jiang,Haopeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SKALD（技能锚定潜在蒸馏）框架：在基于可验证奖励的强化学习中，当 rollout 组内全部正确或全部错误时（占实验中63-68%的组），组相对奖励信号失效。SKALD 通过同一 Qwen3-Base 模型的双上下文视图（仅问题的学生 + 条件于抽象技能卡片的教师）进行在线自蒸馏，利用退火指数倾斜目标稳定分布失配，并通过经验门控仅在验证到正向教师优势时激活蒸馏。在五个数学基准上，0.6B/1.7B/4B 规模下较 GRPO 分别提升 avg@8 +2.46/+4.85/+12.01。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于可验证奖励的强化学习方法依赖组相对信号（如GRPO），但统计发现63-68%的rollout组因全部正确或全部错误而缺乏信息量，导致奖励信号退化。需要寻找不依赖组相对比较的稠密监督来源。

Method: SKALD框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 双上下文自蒸馏：仅问题的学生模型与条件于显式答案过滤技能卡片的教师模型共享参数；(2) 退火指数倾斜目标：下加权教师偏好但学生似然极低的token，随倾斜系数趋零收敛至教师交叉熵，恢复前向KL梯度；(3) 经验门控：仅在可验证rollouts估计出正教师优势时激活蒸馏；另有仅零方差组的蒸馏变体。

Result: 在五个held-out数学基准上，SKALD较GRPO在0.6B/1.7B/4B规模下avg@8分别提升+2.46/+4.85/+12.01。1.7B时，仅零方差组蒸馏恢复84.7%的完整增益；SKALD较FLOP匹配的GRPO高+4.06，较上下文技能暴露方法高+3.77。

Conclusion: 抽象技能卡片在组相对奖励失效时提供了稠密监督信号。SKALD验证了自我蒸馏加上退火倾斜与门控机制能稳定利用技能引导优势，且无需测试时的特权输入，在多个模型规模上一致超越GRPO基线。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards yields no group-relative signal when rollout groups are uniformly correct or uniformly wrong, which account for 63.0-68.0% of groups in our experiments. We propose SKALD (Skill-Anchored Latent Distillation), an on-policy self-distillation framework that uses two context views of the same Qwen3-Base model: a question-only student and a teacher conditioned on an abstract, explicit-answer-filtered skill card. The student is trained on its own prefixes, transferring the skill-induced advantage into shared parameters without privileged input at test time. To stabilize context-induced distribution mismatch, SKALD employs an annealed exponentially tilted objective that downweights teacher-preferred tokens with very low student likelihood; as the tilt vanishes, it converges to teacher cross-entropy and recovers the forward-KL student gradient. An empirical gate activates distillation only when verified rollouts estimate a positive teacher advantage. Across five held-out mathematics benchmarks, SKALD improves overall avg@8 over GRPO by +2.46, +4.85, and +12.01 at 0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B, respectively. At 1.7B, zero-variance-only distillation recovers 84.7% of the full gain, while SKALD remains +4.06 above FLOP-matched GRPO and exceeds contextual skill exposure by +3.77. These results show that abstract skills provide dense supervision where group-relative rewards become uninformative.

</details>


### [542] [Deep Multimodal Wearable Sensor Fusion for Detection of Body-Focused Repetitive Behaviors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09830)
*Samaneh Rezaeimanesh,Mohsen Behradfar,Mohammad Fili,Guiping Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文开发并评估了一种多模态深度学习框架，利用腕戴式传感器数据（IMU、热电堆、飞行时间传感器）检测和分类身体聚焦重复行为（如拔发、抓皮）。该框架结合CNN、GRU、模态自编码器和晚期融合分类器，在二元检测中达到0.985的F1分数和0.997的AUC，在九类分类方案中达到0.700的macro F1和0.963的AUC，并通过SHAP可解释性分析揭示了飞行时间与惯性模态的主导作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 身体聚焦重复行为（如拔发、抓皮）是强迫症和焦虑症常见的强迫性运动，但由于动作细微且与正常手势重叠，早期客观检测非常困难，亟需高效、客观的自动检测方法。

Method: 采用多模态深度学习框架：结合CNN与门控循环单元（GRU）处理时序与空间动态，使用模态特异性自编码器提取各模态特征，并采用晚期融合分类器进行集成；同时利用Shapley可加解释（SHAP）进行后验可解释性分析，并通过层次聚类分析误分类原因。

Result: 二元检测F1分数达0.985、AUC达0.997；九类分类方案macro F1为0.700、AUC为0.963，优于单模态基线。SHAP分析显示飞行时间和惯性模态提供了主要判别力，层次聚类揭示误分类主要由手势解剖区域驱动。

Conclusion: 多模态传感器融合能够实现准确、客观、持续的日常行为监测，为实时可穿戴辅助心理健康诊断和个性化干预奠定了坚实基础，在生物医学研究和临床护理中具有广阔应用前景。

Abstract: Body-focused repetitive behaviors, such as hair pulling and skin picking, are compulsive motor actions commonly associated with obsessive-compulsive and anxiety disorders. Their early, objective detection remains difficult because the movements are subtle and overlap with ordinary, non-pathological gestures. We developed and evaluated a multimodal deep learning framework to detect and classify these behaviors from wrist-worn sensor data. The data, collected by the Child Mind Institute using the Helios wrist-worn device, combine inertial measurement units, thermopile sensors, and time-of-flight sensors, capturing kinematic, thermal, and proximity information. The framework combined a convolutional neural network with a gated recurrent unit, alongside modality-specific autoencoders and a late-fusion classifier, to exploit temporal and spatial dynamics. It achieved an F1 score of 0.985 and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.997 for binary detection, distinguishing these behaviors from other activities, and a macro-averaged F1 score of 0.700 with an area under the curve of 0.963 across a nine-class scheme that distinguished each individual behavior from a single grouped Non-Target class, improving over single-modality baselines. Post-hoc interpretability based on Shapley additive explanations showed that the time-of-flight and inertial modalities dominated discriminative power by capturing spatial proximity and dynamic movement, while hierarchical clustering indicated that misclassifications were driven primarily by the anatomical region of the gesture. These findings demonstrate that multimodal sensor fusion enables accurate, objective, and continuous behavioral monitoring. This work establishes a foundation for real-time, wearable-assisted mental health diagnostics and personalized interventions in biomedical research and clinical care.

</details>


### [543] [Real-Time Climate Risk Assessment for Supply Chain Resilience: A Data-Driven Nowcasting Framework for Colombian Agriculture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09846)
*Hernan J. Silva-Sosa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于数据驱动的短临预报（nowcasting）方法框架，用于哥伦比亚农业供应链的实时气候风险评估，通过整合短期气候预测与供应链风险建模，构建早期预警系统架构，并在受控计算环境中验证了其可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 哥伦比亚气候变异性大（降雨不规则、温度波动、极端事件频发），直接影响农业生产和物流，尤其是对时间敏感的作物。现有方法缺乏将气候短临预报与供应链决策相整合的框架，亟需建立早期预警系统来提升供应链韧性。

Method: 提出一个方法论框架，集成三部分：1）基于历史气象观测的短期气候短临预报；2）供应链风险建模；3）早期预警系统架构。通过明确的风险映射、阈值分类和面向利益相关者的风险信号，将气候预报转化为供应链决策支持信息。原型采用历史气象和农业时间序列（官方统计和再分析产品）在受控计算环境中实现，不依赖卫星影像或计算机视觉组件。

Result: 在合成数据和历史数据实验中，短期降水短临预报可有效转化为农业供应链的可操作风险指标，支持库存、采购和运输方面的前瞻性决策。

Conclusion: 该框架证明了气候短临预报与供应链决策整合的可行性和实用价值，为哥伦比亚农业供应链的气候韧性提升提供了概念性的早期预警系统方案。

Abstract: This paper presents a methodological framework for real-time climate risk assessment using data-driven nowcasting techniques to enhance supply chain resilience in Colombian agricultural contexts. Climate variability in Colombia, characterized by irregular rainfall, temperature fluctuations, and recurrent extreme events, has a direct impact on agricultural production and logistics, particularly for time sensitive crops. The proposed approach integrates short term climate forecasting based on historical meteorological observations with supply chain risk modeling to establish a conceptual early warning system architecture. A prototype implementation developed in a controlled computational environment demonstrates the feasibility of the framework using historical meteorological and agricultural time series derived from official statistics and reanalysis products, without reliance on satellite imagery or computer vision components. The methodology addresses the integration of climate nowcasting with supply chain decision making through explicit risk mapping, threshold-based categorization, and stakeholder-oriented risk signals. Results from synthetic and historical data experiments indicate that short term precipitation nowcasts can be translated into actionable risk indicators for agricultural supply chains, supporting anticipatory decisions related to inventory, sourcing, and transport.

</details>


### [544] [Fairness in Link Prediction Beyond Demographic Parity: A Reproducibility Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09899)
*Valentijn Oldenburg,Floris de Kam,Stef de Wildt,Jarno Nilson Balk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文复现了Mattos等(2025)的声明，证明Δ_DP无法检测排名中的曝光偏差，而rank-aware的NDKL指标能够检测此类差异；同时复现了MORAL后处理方法在提升曝光公平性的同时保持效用的有效性，并在同质性、分类敏感属性等多样化设置下评估了鲁棒性，发布了可复现实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公平排名链接预测中常用的公平性指标Δ_DP（人口均等）可能因忽略链接在排名中的位置而无法检测曝光偏差，需要验证这一说法并评估更先进的曝光感知指标及后处理方法的有效性。

Method: 复现实验：1) 对比Δ_DP与NDKL（排名感知的归一化折扣KL散度）在检测曝光偏差上的能力；2) 复现MORAL后处理方法的效果；3) 在合成同质性设置、分类敏感属性条件下，扩展评估其他公平性/效用指标（包括子群对适配的AWRF），测试鲁棒性。

Result: 结果表明：Δ_DP可能在系统性地对某些子群对链接排名较低时仍显示总体均等（失效）；NDKL能检测此类隐藏偏见；MORAL在多样化设置和数据集上显著降低曝光偏差，且效用损失最小。

Conclusion: 曝光感知指标能够揭示Δ_DP掩盖的偏见，MORAL是有效的公平性后处理方法；研究提供了修正且可复现的实现代码。

Abstract: In fair ranked link prediction, demographic parity ($Δ_\mathrm{DP}$) is a common fairness metric. Yet, Mattos et al. (2025) argue that it fails to detect exposure bias because it ignores where links appear in the ranking. In this study, we reproduce this claim by showing that $Δ_\mathrm{DP}$ can indicate aggregate parity even when some subgroup-pair links are systematically ranked lower than others. The proposed rank-aware Normalized Discounted KL-divergence (NDKL), however, does detect such disparities. We also reproduce the effectiveness of MORAL, a post-processing method that improves exposure-based fairness while maintaining competitive utility. Beyond reproduction, we assess robustness using synthetic homophily settings, categorical sensitive attributes, and additional fairness and utility metrics, including subgroup-pair-adapted Attention-Weighted Rank Fairness (AWRF). Overall, our results show that exposure-based metrics uncover biases hidden by $Δ_\mathrm{DP}$ and that MORAL reduces these biases with minimal utility loss across diverse settings and datasets. We release a corrected, reproducible implementation at https://github.com/Floris93100/reproducing-MORAL.

</details>


<div id='cs.MA'></div>

# cs.MA [[Back]](#toc)

### [545] [MasDrift: Benchmarking Authorization Preservation Across Multi-Agent Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07556)
*Zhuoning Xu,Xiucheng Zhang,Hanjun Luo,Yingbin Jin,Yinpeng Dong,Hanan Salam*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出MasDrift基准，包含600个跨8个领域的良性生产力任务，用于评估多智能体系统中的授权漂移问题。研究发现集中式层级架构在任务完成率上更优（93.9-98.6% vs 85.7-87.0%），但未授权动作发生率更高（2.7-19.8% vs 0.6-0.8%），且差距随层级深度扩大。两种防御机制中，重新锚定到原始用户请求的方法在所有配置下均能减少未授权动作，而链式策略传播会阻碍必要工作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体系统将长时任务分解给主管和子代理，但委派的目标并不自动携带原始授权边界。现有安全基准主要研究对抗性入侵，而约束漂移方面缺乏受控的架构级评估。

Method: 构建MasDrift基准，包含600个良性生产力任务（8个领域）。每个任务将必需工作与保留动作配对。比较单智能体、集中式和分散式协调，同时变化层级深度和同级宽度，衡量任务完成率和授权保留程度。并比较两种防御机制：一种是重新锚定每个待处理调用到原始用户请求；另一种是沿委派链携带衰减策略。

Result: 集中式层级实现93.9-98.6%任务完成率，而同级网络为85.7-87.0%；未授权动作在2.7-19.8%的任务中发生（对比同级网络的0.6-0.8%），差距随层级深度扩大。重新锚定方法在所有模型配置中均减少未授权动作，代价是任务完成率损失1.6个百分点。链式传播则阻碍必需工作，损失高达36.3个百分点。异构案例研究确认失败源于协调方式而非模型能力。

Conclusion: MasDrift揭示了集中化权衡（centralization tradeoff），使授权保留成为MAS设计的可度量属性。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) decompose long-horizon tasks across supervisors and subagents, but delegated goals do not necessarily carry their original authorization boundaries. Existing safety benchmarks mainly study adversarial compromise, while work on constraint drift lacks controlled architecture-level evaluation. We introduce MasDrift, a benchmark of 600 benign productivity tasks across eight domains. Each task pairs required work with reserved actions. MasDrift compares single-agent, centralized, and decentralized coordination while varying hierarchy depth and peer width, measuring task completion and authorization preservation. Across generic multi-agent conditions, centralized hierarchies achieve 93.9--98.6% task completion versus 85.7--87.0% for peer networks, while unauthorized actions occur in 2.7--19.8% of tasks versus 0.6--0.8%, a gap that widens with hierarchy depth. We further compare two defenses that differ in where authorization evidence resides. One re-anchors every pending call to the original user request. The other carries an attenuated policy along the delegation chain. Re-anchoring reduces unauthorized actions in every model configuration we evaluate, at a cost of 1.6 points of pooled completion. Chain propagation blocks required work instead, forfeiting up to 36.3 points. A heterogeneous case study confirms that the failure follows from coordination rather than model strength. MasDrift exposes a centralization tradeoff and makes authorization preservation a measurable property of MAS design.

</details>


### [546] [Mobility, Memory, and Network Structure in Agent-Based Models of Convention Tipping and Convergence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07810)
*Joe Shymanski,Garrick Springer,Sandip Sen*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出一个透明的基于智能体的模型，研究在局部移动性、有界记忆和网络拓扑共同作用下，少数派推动人口放弃旧规范并采纳新规范的临界点动态。研究发现多数配置下颠覆必然发生，因此将分析焦点转向收敛速度，并建立统一预测模型，证明移动性是主导加速因素，记忆和连通性以系统化方式调节收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典临界点研究主要关注变革是否会发生（可行性），但忽略了结构性和行为性因素如何同时影响变革的可能性与时间尺度。本文试图弥合这一空白，探究局部移动性、智能体有界记忆和网络拓扑如何联合影响倾斜阈值与收敛速度。

Method: 构建基于智能体的仿真框架，智能体持有两种行为状态之一，移动的少数派群体试图推翻现有规范。通过自定义仿真框架系统性地改变局部移动性、记忆长度和网络拓扑参数，观察颠覆阈值与收敛时间；在此基础之上提出一个统一的预测模型来估计从结构行为参数到完全采纳所需时间的关系。

Result: 发现许多配置下颠覆几乎不可避免——只要有足够时间，人口总会收敛到少数派状态。因此作者转而分析收敛的速度，并建立了能准确估计结构性与行为性参数如何决定完全采纳所需时间的统一预测模型。结果表明移动性是主导加速因素，而记忆和连通性以系统化方式调节收敛过程。

Conclusion: 该研究将结构性和行为性因素同时与规范变革的可能性及其时间尺度联系起来，扩展了经典临界点研究。虽然模型以二元行为采纳为框架，但相同的机制也适用于规范变迁及其他类似传染的社会过程。

Abstract: Tipping-point dynamics describe the critical conditions under which a committed minority drives a population to abandon an established convention in favor of a new one. We present a transparent agent-based model of this process, in which agents hold one of two behavioral states and a mobile committed minority attempts to overturn the incumbent convention. Our goal was to examine how localized mobility, bounded agent memory, and network topology jointly influence the tipping threshold. Using a custom agent-based simulation framework, we found that in many configurations, tipping becomes effectively inevitable: given sufficient time, the population always converges to the minority state. This observation motivated a complementary analysis focused on the pace of convergence rather than its feasibility. We introduce a unified predictive model that accurately estimates how structural and behavioral parameters determine the time required for complete adoption, showing that mobility is the dominant accelerator while memory and connectivity modulate convergence in systematic ways. Together, these results extend classical tipping-point research by linking structural and behavioral factors not only to the likelihood of convention change but also to the timescale on which it unfolds. While we frame the model in terms of convention-like binary behavioral adoption, the same mechanisms bear on norm change and other contagion-like social processes.

</details>


### [547] [Per-Shipment Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Intermodal Freight Routing Under Hurricane Disruption](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07824)
*Aliza Sharmin,Xudong Wang,Mustafa Can Camur,Xueping Li*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文研究气候极端事件对多式联运货运网络的干扰问题，将其建模为具有逐票货物决策粒度的Dec-POMDP，并对比IPPO、MAPPO及两种启发式基线在15节点枢纽网络上受飓风干扰下的表现。结果显示无单一策略全面占优：IPPO在吞吐量和交付率上领先，容量感知启发式在弹性指数和延误上更优；在需求激增时IPPO优势扩大，而MAPPO因训练-评估队列不匹配而崩溃。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多式联运货运网络面临日益增长的气候极端事件干扰风险，这类事件会同时使多条走廊性能退化。现有方法缺乏对多走廊同时失效场景下逐票货物路由决策的充分研究，需要更鲁棒的货运路由策略。

Method: 将货运路由问题建模为具有逐票货物动作粒度的Dec-POMDP；采用集中训练-分散执行的IPPO方法进行训练；在15枢纽网络、飓风干扰情境下，与两种拥有特权状态访问的启发式基线进行对比实验；并额外测试了MAPPO变体及需求激增场景。

Result: 30个匹配回合中：IPPO吞吐量最高（+12.7%）且交付率最优；容量感知启发式在弹性指数和延误上领先。需求激增（2.9:1容量比）时IPPO的弹性指数优势扩大至+6.4%。MAPPO在训练-评估队列不匹配下崩溃（RI=0.811），重训后恢复至1.018，但吞吐量仍不及IPPO。

Conclusion: 学习型路由在容量紧张时价值最大；集中式critic在逐票调度机制下存在残余局限；不同策略在不同指标上各有优势，需根据运营优先级选择，或探索更优的集中-分散结合方式。

Abstract: Intermodal freight networks face growing disruption risk from climate extremes that degrade multiple corridors simultaneously. To address this, we formulate freight routing as a Dec-POMDP with per-shipment action granularity and train Independent PPO (IPPO) under Centralized Training with Decentralized Execution, comparing against two heuristic baselines with privileged state access on a 15-hub network under hurricane disruption. Across 30 matched episodes, no single policy dominates: IPPO achieves the highest throughput ($+12.7\%$) and delivery rate while a capacity-aware heuristic leads on Resilience Index (RI) and delay. Under demand surge (2.9:1 capacity ratio), IPPO's RI advantage grows to $+6.4\%$, suggesting learned routing is most valuable when capacity is scarce. A Multi-Agent PPO (MAPPO) variant collapses under train-eval queue mismatch ($\mathrm{RI} = 0.811$); retraining recovers RI to $1.018$ but IPPO still leads on throughput, pointing to residual limitations in centralized critics under per-shipment dispatch.

</details>


### [548] [Decentralized Multi-Agent Urban Traffic Management via Spatio-Temporal Mobility Profile Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08035)
*Lorenzo Mario Amorosa,Lorenzo Farina,Vittorio Todisco,Alessandro Bazzi*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: VeloCity是一个去中心化的多智能体时空移动性轮廓规划框架，专为在任意城市区域运行的CAV设计。该框架将移动性轮廓优化分布到各CAV，车辆查询本地交通协调器获取预约表，独立计算最快无冲突移动性轮廓并返回预约时空槽。框架天然适配任意道路拓扑，无需场景特定调参，同时保证无碰撞和物理可执行的车辆轨迹。在东京、曼哈顿、罗马和博洛尼亚四个大规模真实城市地图上的仿真验证了其可扩展性，相比现有最先进模型大幅降低旅行时间、严格控制延迟方差，并在极高车辆密度下成功防止交通拥堵僵局。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CAV交通管理方法存在三大局限：一是通常优化局部交互而非系统级效率；二是产生严重通信开销；三是缺乏安全运动学执行所需的确定性保证。此外，当前多智能体方法常局限于小型预定义场景，难以扩展到大型复杂城市网络。

Method: VeloCity采用去中心化架构：每个CAV查询本地交通协调器获取预约表，独立计算自身最快的无冲突时空移动性轮廓，然后向协调器预约所需时空槽。该框架原生适配任意道路拓扑，无需场景特定调参，同时保证无碰撞且物理上可执行的轨迹。

Result: 在东京、曼哈顿、罗马和博洛尼亚四个大规模真实城市地图上的广泛仿真表明：与现有最先进模型相比，VeloCity大幅降低旅行时间，严格控制延迟方差，并在极高车辆密度下成功防止拥堵僵局。

Conclusion: VeloCity通过去中心化的预约机制和自适应任意道路拓扑的设计，实现了系统级效率优化与安全保证的兼顾，为大规模城市环境中CAV的交通管理提供了可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: As modern cities face increasingly severe traffic congestion, connected and autonomous vehicles (CAVs) have emerged as a crucial enabling technology for next-generation intelligent traffic management. However, fully realizing this potential is hindered by the limitations of current paradigms. Existing approaches typically optimize localized interactions rather than system-wide efficiency, incur severe communication overhead, or lack the deterministic guarantees required for safe kinematic execution. Furthermore, current multi-agent adaptations are frequently restricted to small predefined scenarios, failing to scale across large and complex urban networks. To bridge this gap, this paper introduces VeloCity, a decentralized multi-agent spatio-temporal mobility profile planning framework designed for CAVs operating in arbitrary urban areas. To minimize vehicles' travel times, VeloCity distributes mobility profile optimization directly to individual CAVs. Vehicles query a localized traffic coordinator for a reservation table, independently compute their fastest conflict-free mobility profile, and reserve their requested space-time slots back with the coordinator. By natively adapting to any arbitrary road topology, the framework manages highly irregular urban areas without requiring scenario-specific tuning, all while guaranteeing collision-free and physically executable vehicle trajectories. Extensive simulations across four large-scale real-world urban maps (Tokyo, Manhattan, Rome, and Bologna) demonstrate the framework's scalability. Compared to established state-of-the-art models, VeloCity yields drastically lower travel times, tightly bounds delay variance, and successfully prevents congestion gridlocks even under extremely high vehicular densities.

</details>


### [549] [AOC-CBS: Anytime-Optimal Continuous-time Conflict-Based Search for Generalised Multi-Agent Path Finding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08175)
*Alvin Combrink,Sabino Francesco Roselli,Martin Fabian*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出AOC-CBS，一个泛化MAPF问题的任意时间最优的精确且解完整的求解器。它支持异构车队、非几何冲突、任务序列及完成任务后继续移动的智能体，并通过修复函数组合和并行计算实现大规模扩展，在可接受有界最优性差距时可将可扩展性从数十个智能体提升到数百个。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统MAPF研究存在多项限制性假设：离散时间、圆形智能体共享单一空间图、每个智能体单一目标、到达目标后必须停留。这些假设排除了异构车队、非几何冲突、任务序列和完成任务后继续移动的场景，无法适应仓库、道路、机场等现实应用的复杂需求。

Method: 将MAPF形式化推广以去除上述假设，提出Anytime-Optimal Continuous-time Conflict-Based Search (AOC-CBS)求解器。它保证最终返回最优解，并在运行过程中持续报告具有已知最优性差距上界的当前可行解；配备修复函数组合（其中引入Tier-Prioritized Safe Interval Path Planning），并能利用多核处理器并行计算。

Result: 在混合非凸智能体车队沿平滑、运动动力学可行轨迹运行的场景中验证了AOC-CBS。与精确求解器OC-CBS在知名基准和采样路网上的初步实验表明，AOC-CBS在寻找最优解方面性能相当，且在接受有界最优性差距时可将可扩展性从数十个智能体扩展到数百个。

Conclusion: AOC-CBS在保持最优解能力的同时大幅提升了MAPF泛化问题的可扩展性，为异构、连续时间、多任务场景下的多智能体路径规划提供了实用且可配置的解决方案。

Abstract: Many research fields share a common structure: a set of agents, each pursuing its own goal, whose actions must be coordinated so that no two of them conflict. Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) is a concrete instance of this structure, with applications from warehouses to road traffic and airports. Much of MAPF research assumes discrete time, circular agents sharing one spatial graph, a single goal per agent, and that an agent must remain at its goal once reached, precluding heterogeneous fleets, non-geometric conflicts, task sequences, and agents that move on after completing them. We generalise the MAPF formulation to lift these assumptions, and present Anytime-Optimal Continuous-time Conflict-Based Search (AOC-CBS), an exact and solution-complete solver for it. AOC-CBS guarantees the eventual return of an optimal solution, while reporting an incumbent with a known optimality gap upper bound throughout its runtime; it is configurable with a portfolio of repair functions, one of which we introduce (Tier-Prioritized Safe Interval Path Planning), and can exploit multiple processor cores. We demonstrate AOC-CBS on a mixed fleet of non-convex agents moving along smooth, kinodynamically feasible trajectories. Preliminary experiments against the exact solver OC-CBS, on well-known benchmarks and roadmaps we sample from them, show AOC-CBS is comparable at finding optimal solutions while extending scalability from the tens to the hundreds of agents when a bounded optimality gap is accepted.

</details>


### [550] [Fluid Structure, Rigid Record: A Layered Organizational Design Framework for Agent-Native Organizations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08516)
*Lucian Zhu*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种智能体原生组织架构框架，将组织操作分为持久层与动态层：持久层包含四库记录架构和驻留专业化智能体；协调层通过Permission（操作世界边界）与Privilege（授权状态变更）编译任务特定操作世界；运行时层结合外部工作流协议与隔离运行时库动态组装任务组；人机交互层通过控制平面和非决策翻译智能体暴露组织。三种正交角色组（执行、审查、监督）实现权力分离，该系统在操作表面灵活、底层结构刚性。已实现原型并在小样本实验中评估，尚未声明总体性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大多数多智能体系统（MAS）仍将组织视为会话拓扑、角色提示或固定工作流，这未能体现智能体原生组织的本质。作者认为代理组织不应仅仅是一组带有企业头衔的模型实例，因此需要一种更严谨、可验证的组织结构框架来设计、治理、恢复和评估智能体原生组织。

Method: 提出分层架构：1) 持久层：四库记录架构+驻留专业智能体池；2) 协调层：Permission定义操作世界边界，Privilege定义授权状态变更，编译任务特定操作世界；3) 运行时层：外部工作流协议+隔离运行时库，动态组装任务组；4) 人机交互层：控制平面+非决策翻译智能体。引入三种正交角色组（操作/审查/监督），实现执行者受限租约、审查者按需提升权限、监督者广泛观察但有限修改的分权机制。

Result: 架构已作为原型实现并在小样本实验中评估。任务和事件可以改变团队组成、拓扑、视图、工具和工作流，而记录、写入约束、权限边界和权力分离保持持久。大规模实证验证尚未完成，因此未提出总体性能声明。

Conclusion: 本文的主要贡献并非性能声明，而是一个连贯且可证伪的智能体原生组织设计、治理、恢复和评估框架，为后续大规模实证研究奠定理论基础。

Abstract: An agentic organization should not be a set of model instances with corporate titles, despite most MAS still operationalizing organization as a conversational topology, a role prompt, or a fixed workflow. This paper develops an agent-native organizational structure framework that separates the persistent and dynamic layers of operations. The persistent layer consists of a four-store record architecture and a pool of resident specialization agents. A coordination layer defines Permission as the boundary of the operational world available to an agent, and Privilege as the set of organizational state changes that the agent is authorized to initiate. Together, these mechanisms compile task-specific operational worlds. A runtime layer combines an external Workflow Protocol with an isolated runtime store to dynamically assemble Task Groups. A human-interaction layer exposes the organization through a Control Plane mediated by a non-decision-making Translation Agent. Three orthogonal Role Groups further separate Operation, Review, and Supervision. Operators execute within narrowly scoped leases; reviewers receive elevated but demand-activated authority to modify organizational state; supervisors retain broad observational access while holding limited modification authority. The resulting architecture is fluid at the execution surface but structurally rigid underneath: tasks and events may alter team composition, topology, views, tools, and workflows, while records, write constraints, authority boundaries, and separation of powers remain persistent. The architecture has been implemented as a prototype and evaluated in small-sample experiments. Large-scale empirical validation remains incomplete, therefore no general performance claimed is made yet. Instead, the contribution is a coherent and falsifiable framework for designing, governing, recovering, and evaluating agent-native organizations.

</details>


### [551] [Muscle Memory for Agents: Compile not Merely Retrieve](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08995)
*Pouya Ghiasnezhad Omran,Soujanya Lanka,Qin Zhang,Tanya Dixit*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出"肌肉记忆"（Muscle Memory）这一新的记忆范式：将用户反复出现的意图编译为专用专家代理（specialist agents），而非传统基于检索的模式。通过四阶段流水线（Harvest→Analyze→Augment→Evaluate）从对话历史中挖掘行为模式并生成质量门控的专家代理，实验显示在90个场景中获胜率88.9%，个性化增益+2.05，准确率代价仅-0.28。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM代理的记忆架构统一采用"存储文本/嵌入/反思/规则→检索→通用编排器解释"的模式，但该模式在个性化场景下是错误默认。用户在需要领域适配回答时被迫重复纠正格式、深度和范围，产生"多轮代价"（multi-turn tax）。文章主张编译（compilation）比检索（retrieval）更适合此类工作负载。

Method: 提出四阶段流水线：(1) Harvest：挖掘对话历史；(2) Analyze：分离行为模式与任务模式；(3) Augment：生成质量门控的可执行编译专家；(4) Evaluate：两阶段触发匹配（two-stage trigger matching）评估。核心思想是将反复出现的用户意图"编译"成专用化专家代理，而非仅在推理时检索通用记忆。

Result: 在5个用户角色的90个保留场景中，增强后的助手在专家触发的36个案例中赢得32个，胜率88.9%；在1-4分制上个性化增益+2.05，准确率代价仅-0.28。

Conclusion: 编译范式在此场景下优于检索范式，该结果对更广泛的记忆设计空间有启示意义，但仍存在开放问题需要解决。作者将其定位为与检索并列的独立记忆范式，而非检索的替代或补充。

Abstract: Memory for LLM agents has converged on a single architectural pattern: store experience as text, embeddings, reflections, or rules; retrieve at inference time; let a general-purpose orchestrator interpret what to do. This paper argues that the pattern is the wrong default for personalization. We position Muscle Memory - the practice of compiling recurring user intent into purpose-built specialist agents - as a distinct memory paradigm from retrieval, and we argue that compilation is a better fit for the workloads where current assistants impose a multi-turn tax on their users: making them repeatedly correct format, depth, and scope to obtain a domain-appropriate answer. We support the position with a reference implementation and empirical evidence. The implementation is a four-phase pipeline (Harvest $\rightarrow$ Analyze $\rightarrow$ Augment $\rightarrow$ Evaluate) that mines conversational history, separates behavioral from task patterns, and emits quality-gated executable compiled specialists with two-stage trigger matching. On 90 held-out scenarios across five user personas, the augmented assistant wins 32 of 36 cases where a specialist fires, an 88.9% win rate, with a +2.05 personalization gain and only a $-0.28$ accuracy cost on a 1-4 scale. We discuss why compilation is better suited than retrieval in this regime, what the result implies for the broader memory design space, and what open problems remain.

</details>


### [552] [Beyond Tier Labels: Role- and Deployment-Dependent Model Substitution in Multi-Call LLM Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09155)
*Renxiang Wang,Jiaming Cui*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出一种"谓词-动作"分解方法，将大模型多调用系统中的路由决策分离为"在哪里花费更强模型"（放置）和"替换本身的价值"（动作），并通过受控的solve-merge-verify工作流（8-64次求解调用、四组三层模型阶梯）验证，揭示模型替换是部署条件化的动作而非层级标签的属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有查询级路由无法捕捉大型多调用LLM系统的问题：模型的价值取决于它在依赖计算中的位置以及周围部署环境。现有路由器通常决定在哪里使用更强模型，但将替换的收益视为已知，这忽略了替换动作本身在不同角色和规模下的差异化价值。

Method: 通过谓词-动作分解将两个决策（在哪里放置强模型 vs 替换动作的价值）分离，在受控的solve-merge-verify工作流中评估，涵盖8-64次求解调用和四组三层模型阶梯，并采用输入匹配干预和分配消融实验进行验证。

Result: 在数值频率计数任务上，全强模型将RMSE从4.818降至1.538（Mixed Qwen/GPT阶梯），而平均Qwen-only排序则发生逆转。输入匹配干预显示相同的中到强替换动作在不同角色和规模下价值差异显著。语义任务与契约转换再次逆转Mixed排序，分配消融则区分了有用的稀疏放置与欠覆盖及不加区分的升级。

Conclusion: 模型替换是部署条件化的动作而非层级标签暗示的属性。提出了大规模工作流路由的实用序列：先校准动作，再解析其角色条件化效应，最后优化其放置。

Abstract: Large multi-call LLM systems pose a scientific problem that query-level routing does not capture: the value of a model depends on where it enters a dependent computation and on the deployment that surrounds that call. Existing routers typically decide \emph{where} to spend a stronger model while treating the benefit of the substitution itself as known. We separate these two decisions through a predicate-action factorization and evaluate it in controlled solve-merge-verify workflows spanning 8-64 solve calls and four three-tier model ladders. The resulting evidence reveals a consistent principle beneath apparently conflicting outcomes. On numeric frequency counting, all-strong reduces RMSE from 4.818 to 1.538 in the Mixed Qwen/GPT ladder, whereas the average Qwen-only ordering reverses. Input-matched interventions further show that the same medium-to-strong action has sharply different value across roles and scales. A semantic task-and-contract shift reverses the Mixed ordering again, while allocation ablations distinguish useful sparse placement from under-coverage and indiscriminate escalation. Together, these results establish model substitution as a deployment-conditioned action rather than a property implied by a tier label, and they provide a practical sequence for large-scale workflow routing: calibrate the action, resolve its role-conditioned effect, and then optimize its placement.

</details>


### [553] [MoRSE: Task-Oriented Multi-Agent System with Mixture of Role-Subtask Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09251)
*Peiwen Li,Shiyang Zhang,Yangtian Zhang,Sizhuang He,David van Dijk,Rex Ying*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 提出MoRSE框架，通过(角色,子任务)条件化在任务结构和参数层面区分多智能体，并采用原型语义路由器和分层组相对策略优化，显著提升复杂长时程任务的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型多智能体系统主要依赖粗粒度的提示词级区分，缺乏针对不同子任务的参数自适应，导致智能体间异质性不足、专业化能力有限，成为复杂任务性能提升的瓶颈。

Method: 1) 将任务分解为依赖感知的有向无环图(DAG)，为每个智能体分配特定(角色,子任务)；2) 提出动态(角色,子任务)LoRA专家模块，配合基于原型的语义路由器实现参数级专业化；3) 提出分层组相对策略优化(HGRPO)，通过两层信用分配将专家更新与路由决策引起的方差隔离。

Result: 在三个骨干模型上的代码生成基准测试中，整体任务与逐步性能均有提升，且训练获得的专业化能力可泛化到未见过的任务类别和领域。

Conclusion: 同时从任务结构和参数两个层面实现智能体的专业化区分，能有效突破多智能体系统的性能瓶颈，且具有良好的泛化能力。

Abstract: Large language model-based multi-agent systems have recently shown strong potential for complex, long-horizon tasks. However, existing methods mainly rely on coarse prompt-level differentiation without parameter adaptation for diverse subtasks, resulting in insufficient inter-agent heterogeneity and limited specialized capability that bottleneck performance on tasks with complex requirements. To address this, we introduce a Task-Oriented Multi-Agent System with Mixture of Role-Subtask Experts (MoRSE) that distinguishes agents with (role, subtask)-conditional specialization at both the task structure and parameter levels. To make agents' responsibility explicit at the task structure level, we formulate a task-oriented multi-agent system that decomposes each task into a dependency-aware Directed Acyclic Graph of subtasks and assigns each agent a specific (role, subtask), introducing task-level specialization across collaborating agents. Additionally, to address the diverse role and subtask parameter adaptation demands, we propose a dynamic Mixture of (role, subtask) LoRA Experts module with a prototype-based semantic router for subtasks, augmenting agents with parameter-level specialization on a shared LLM substrate cost-effectively. Then, to co-optimize experts and router stably under sparse task rewards, we further propose a hierarchical group-relative policy optimization with two-layer credit assignment that isolates expert updates from the cross-route variance introduced by routing decisions, disentangling expert quality from routing quality. Experiments on code-generation benchmarks across three backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, with improvements in both whole-task and step-wise performance, and the gains from trained specialization generalize across held-out task categories and domains.

</details>


### [554] [Distributed Team Orchestration via Supervisor Networks: Convergence, Optimality, and Resilience](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09256)
*Juntian Zhu,Guanpu Chen,Tongtian Zhu,Miguel de Carvalho,Zhouwang Yang,Fengxiang He*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文研究零和势团队博弈中的监督者网络学习问题，提出分布式团队编排算法（DTOA），结合团队虚构博弈与基于监督者的分布式信念学习，在信念不准确和拜占庭团队存在的情况下，证明收敛到近团队纳什均衡，并提供了拜占庭弹性变体的概率性识别保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多智能体团队博弈中，智能体通常依赖监督者提供的信念信息而非精确的公共信念，但这类信念信息可能因监督者的估计误差和拜占庭团队的错误报告而失真，这对收敛到团队纳什均衡构成挑战，需要设计鲁棒的学习算法。

Method: 提出分布式团队编排算法（DTOA），核心是将团队虚构博弈（team fictitious play）与基于监督者的分布式信念学习相结合。在拜占庭设置下，引入误报攻击模型，并开发拜占庭弹性的DTOA变体以识别恶意团队并保持学习性能。

Result: 证明了监督者信念估计的收敛性，以及诱导的学习动力学在团队纳什间隙（TNG）意义下收敛到近团队纳什均衡；在拜占庭设置下，提供了拜占庭团队识别的概率性保证，并建立了诚实团队TNG的渐近界。数值实验验证了理论结果并与基线方法对比。

Conclusion: DTOA在不精确信念和拜占庭攻击环境下仍能有效实现近团队纳什均衡收敛，为实际多智能体团队博弈系统提供了理论保障和实用算法。

Abstract: In this paper, we study zero-sum potential team games with a supervisor network, where agents rely on supervisor-provided belief information rather than accurate common beliefs. The main challenge is that such belief information can be inaccurate because of supervisors' belief-estimation errors and the misreporting of joint actions by Byzantine teams. We propose the distributed team-orchestrating algorithm (DTOA), which combines team fictitious play with supervisor-based distributed belief learning. We prove the convergence of supervisors' belief estimates and establish that the induced learning dynamics converge to a near team-Nash equilibrium (TNE) in terms of the team-Nash gap (TNG). In the Byzantine setting, we consider a misreporting attack model and develop a Byzantine-resilient DTOA. We further provide probabilistic guarantees for Byzantine-team identification and establish an asymptotic bound on the honest TNG. Numerical experiments illustrate the theoretical findings, compare DTOA with baseline learning methods, and evaluate its performance in a Markov decision process setting.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [555] [Towards an Argumentative Foundation for Evaluative AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07473)
*Xiang Yin,Tim Miller,Nico Potyka,Antonio Rago,Francesca Toni*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，主张将（计算）论证作为评估型人工智能（EAI）的形式化与可计算基础，以支持可解释和可质疑的EAI系统，并为分布式、以人为中心的EAI研究奠定长期议程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估型AI（EAI）被提出用于支持人类决策，不同于传统AI给出单一推荐，而是呈现竞争性假设及其支持与反对证据。然而，EAI缺乏一个正式、可计算的理论基础来实现可解释性和可质疑性。

Method: 作者采用立场论文的形式，论证计算论证（Computational Argumentation）范式是构建可解释、可质疑的EAI系统的合适基础，并展望了分布式和人本中心EAI系统的长期研究议程。

Result: 该论文提出了一个概念性框架，将计算论证与EAI相结合，为EAI提供了形式化的逻辑基础，使系统能够呈现竞争假设及其证据，并支持人类对AI决策的质疑与反驳。

Conclusion: 计算论证为EAI提供了理想的形式化基础，能够实现可解释和可争议的AI决策支持系统，未来研究方向指向分布式和人本中心的EAI系统设计。

Abstract: Evaluative AI (EAI) has been recently proposed as a way to support human decision-making, not by producing a single recommendation, but by presenting competing hypotheses together with evidence for and against each. In this position paper, we advocate (computational) argumentation as a particularly suitable paradigm to provide a formal, computable foundation for forms of EAI that are explainable and contestable, setting the ground for a long-term research agenda towards distributed and human-centred EAI systems.

</details>


### [556] [Flow-by-Flow:Content-Judgment Bypass for Governing AI Output in High-Loss Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07474)
*Hiroki Naito*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Flow-by-Flow治理范式，解决AI高速输出超越人类认知容量的监督难题。核心洞察是约束条件不是V（输出速度）而是V×L（每项认知负荷），且AI能力提升只会重构而非降低负荷结构。Flow-by-Flow通过形式化可计数特征施加非线性成本、并以制度性能力上限将处理量约束在人类容量C_max内，实现无需评估内容的负载控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究表明，当AI输出速度V超过人类认知容量C_max时，人在环路（human-in-the-loop）监督在高层损场景下结构性地不可行。但先前工作忽视了关键因素L（每项认知负荷）。L由分诊（triage）、判断（judgment）和响应（response）三部分构成，且三者对AI能力改进的响应不对称：分诊成本因语义不确定性的固有性而不下降，响应成本对精度改进不变，只有判断成本面临下行压力且常以"遗漏"而非真正减少的方式实现。这意味着传统基于内容正确性的治理机制必然面临两难：委托AI评估则继承幻觉风险，委托人类评估则撞上V×L天花板。

Method: 提出Flow-by-Flow治理范式，其核心策略是控制监督负载而不评估内容。具体包括两个机制：（1）基于形式化、可计数特征的认知成本评分，对高产量施加非线性成本；（2）制度性能力上限，将处理量约束在C_max以内。此外，推导出任何内容判断绕过（content-judgment-bypass）超限路径的四个设计不变量：无内容判断、不可规模化消耗审查员容量、身份绑定的每应用摩擦、无批量清关。并通过一个参考实现和蒙特卡洛模拟（1,000次参数抽样）验证可行性。

Result: 参考实现证明了四个设计不变量可以联合满足，但其实际困难也被明确承认。蒙特卡洛分析（1,000次参数抽样）显示，复合多指标流量控制（composite multi-metric flow control）在90.8%的试验中优于单纯的监督强化（supervision reinforcement alone）。

Conclusion: 能力提升重构L而非减少L，因此需要重新设计治理机制。Flow-by-Flow展示了"绕过内容判断"而非"改进内容判断"是可行的治理路径，为高层损场景下的AI监督提供了新的范式方向。

Abstract: Prior work showed that human-in-the-loop oversight becomes structurally untenable in high-loss domains when AI output velocity V exceeds human cognitive capacity C_max. The operative constraint, however, is not V alone but V x L, where L denotes per-item cognitive load. L consists of triage, judgment, and response, which respond asymmetrically to AI capability improvement. Triage cost does not decline as models become more capable, because semantic indeterminacy is inherent in general-purpose design. Response cost is invariant to accuracy improvements. Only judgment cost faces downward pressure, and this pressure often operates by inducing omission rather than genuine reduction. Capability improvement therefore restructures L rather than reducing it. Governance mechanisms based on evaluating whether AI output is correct either delegate that evaluation to AI and inherit hallucination risk, or delegate it to humans and face the V x L ceiling. We propose Flow-by-Flow, a governance paradigm that controls supervisory load without evaluating content. A cognitive cost score based on formal, countable features imposes nonlinear costs on high-volume production, while an institutional capacity cap keeps processing volume within C_max. We derive four design invariants for any content-judgment-bypass exceedance pathway: no content judgment, no scalable consumption of examiner capacity, identity-bound per-application friction, and no batch clearance. One reference implementation is discussed to show that these invariants are jointly satisfiable, while its practical difficulties are explicitly acknowledged. An illustrative Monte Carlo analysis across 1,000 parameter draws suggests that composite multi-metric flow control outperforms supervision reinforcement alone in 90.8% of trials.

</details>


### [557] [Determinization in Structure Theories: A Unified Framework via Closure, Comparability, and Joint Admissibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07476)
*Hai Hai Fu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个形式化框架，用于从多元结构理论中构建规范解释。区分了三种规范化的层次（闭包稳定化、全局完成、确定化），并将非确定性分类为认知多元性（Type E）和结构多元性（Type S）。提出了两种规范化机制（基于算子的完成和基于选择器的构造），并证明了相关结构条件。框架还应用于LLM辅助推理，将幻觉解释为不支持的规范化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前对于"从多元结构理论中构建规范解释"缺乏统一的形式化框架。研究者希望系统地理解何时以及如何能从允许多种一致解释的理论中提取唯一的、规范的解释，同时区分不同类型的不确定性来源。

Method: 引入结构理论T=(Σ, A, I)的三元组定义，区分三个规范化层次：闭包稳定化、全局完成、确定化。将非确定性分为Type E（认知性）和Type S（结构性），并提出Type S-strong子类。提出两种机制：算子式完成（operator-based completion）和选择器式构造（selector-based construction），并通过多级规范化算子的组合研究系统的非交换性。

Result: 证明了纯推理式完成在正、非收缩规则及额外可靠性条件下可归结为饱和闭包算子。Type E理论可实现闭包稳定化，完全确定化依赖开放的全汇合性质。Type S-strong理论通过规范选择实现确定化。多级规范化构成结构化非交换系统，并给出了将理论内在机制归约为闭包或选择的分类定理。

Conclusion: 该框架统一了多元结构理论中的规范化问题，提供了清晰的不确定性分类学和机制分析，同时揭示了Type E理论的完全确定化仍是一个开放问题。应用方面，将LLM幻觉建模为"不支持的规范化"，为形式化理解大模型推理行为提供了新视角。

Abstract: We develop a formal framework for constructing canonical interpretations from plural structure theories. A structure theory is a triple T = (Σ, A, I) consisting of a signature, axioms, and an inference policy, whose admissible interpretation family collects all globally consistent assignments of structural conclusions.
  We distinguish three levels of canonicalization: closure stabilization (per-seed convergence), global completion (seed-independent convergence), and determinization (a unique admissible interpretation). Non-determinism is classified into epistemic plurality (Type E) and structural plurality (Type S), with a refined Type S-strong subclass characterized by the absence of common upper bounds.
  Two canonicalization mechanisms arise: operator-based completion and selector-based construction. We provide sufficient structural conditions under which these mechanisms exist, and show that pure inference-based completion reduces to a saturated closure operator under positive, non-retractive rules with an additional soundness condition. For Type E theories, closure stabilization is established, while full determinization depends on a global confluence property that remains open. For Type S-strong theories, determinization is achieved via canonical selection.
  We further show that multi-level canonicalization forms a structurally non-commutative system via staged operators, and provide a conditional classification theorem reducing theory-intrinsic mechanisms to closure or selection. The framework also applies to LLM-assisted reasoning, where hallucination can be viewed as unsupported canonicalization.

</details>


### [558] [Emotion in an active inference model of human driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07480)
*Julian F. Schumann,Johan Engström,Ran Wei,Jens Kober,Martijn Wisse,Arkady Zgonnikov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种在连续状态空间中，从驾驶的主动推理模型中提取效价（valence）和唤醒度（arousal）情感信号的方法，并通过两个交互驾驶场景验证了情感信号与真实驾驶情境中的情感模式一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主动推理驾驶模型未考虑情感状态对决策的影响，而先前非交通领域的主动推理情感建模仅局限于离散状态空间的简化场景，无法应用于更复杂的连续状态驾驶模型。

Method: 作者提出了一个扩展的效价与唤醒度公式，不仅基于当前状态，还结合预测的未来结果来条件化情感估计，并将其嵌入到具有连续状态的主动推理驾驶模型中。

Result: 在两个交互式驾驶场景中评估了所提方法，结果表明产生的情感信号与类似场景中报告的情感模式相符。

Conclusion: 该工作首次将情感建模扩展到连续状态的主动推理驾驶框架中，为更真实的驾驶行为建模铺平了道路。

Abstract: Active inference has emerged as a principled framework for modeling adaptive behavior by balancing goal-directed action with uncertainty reduction. It has been successfully applied across biological and artificial systems, including recent work on human driving. However, existing active inference models of driving have yet to address an important determinant of behavior in traffic: affective state, which significantly influences decision-making. Prior work in non-traffic domains has explored active inference agents in which emotions are represented along the axes of valence and arousal in the circumplex model. However, this work has been limited to simplified settings with discrete state spaces. In this work, we propose an expanded formulation of valence and arousal that can be extracted from a more complex active inference model of driving with continuous states. In particular, we condition affective estimates not only on the current state but also on predicted future outcomes. We evaluate the proposed approach in two interactive driving scenarios and show that the resulting emotion signals correspond to affective patterns reported in similar scenarios.

</details>


### [559] [Training Variable Long Sequences with Data-Centric Parallel](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07524)
*Geng Zhang,Xuanlei Zhao,Kai Wang,Yang You*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Data-Centric Parallel (DCP)，一种以数据驱动运行时配置的分布式训练方法，通过根据每个batch的序列长度动态调整并行大小、梯度累积和重计算等运行时设置，在32块H200 GPU上实现最高2.88倍加速，且仅需10行代码即可集成到任意模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练变长序列的深度学习模型面临计算挑战，现有方法在效率和易用性之间存在难以调和的权衡：简单方法使用静态配置导致负载不均和低效率，而复杂方法则引入大量代码改动和实现复杂度。

Method: DCP的核心原则是让数据本身驱动运行时。具体做法是根据每个batch的序列长度动态调整直接运行时设置，包括并行大小（parallel size）、梯度累积（gradient accumulation）和重计算（recomputation）等参数，实现按批次自适应的训练配置。

Result: 在32块H200 GPU上实现最高2.88倍的加速比。方法具有良好的泛化性，仅需10行代码即可集成到任何现有模型中。

Conclusion: 这种简单而有效的方法有望成为变长长序列分布式训练的稳健基线，并为该领域的未来发展提供基础。

Abstract: Training deep learning models on variable long sequences poses significant computational challenges. Existing methods force a difficult trade-off between efficiency and ease-of-use. Simple approaches use static configurations that cause workload imbalance low efficiency, while complex methods introduces significant complexity and code change for new models. To break this trade-off, we introduce Data-Centric Parallel (DCP). Its core principle is to let the data itself drive the runtime. It achieves this by dynamically adjusting direct runtime settings (e.g., parallel size, gradient accumulation, recomputation) based on each batch's sequence length. Empirical results demonstrate that our method achieves up to a 2.88$\times$ speedup on 32 H200 GPUs. Designed for generalization, it can be integrated into any model with 10 lines of code. We anticipate this simple yet effective approach will serve as a robust baseline and facilitate future advancements in distributed training for variable long sequences.

</details>


### [560] [The Knowing-Saying Gap: When Probes See Errors that Confidence Misses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07528)
*Jyotin Goel,Ipshita Bandyopadhyay,Justin Shenk*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 线性探针能以近乎完美的准确率检测语言模型中的上下文损坏，但这并不能转化为可靠的失败预测。通过在多种模型（包括推理模型）上的多跳算术链实验，论文证明了探针检测与最终答案正确性之间存在解离，并驳斥了预注册的"持久性胜过峰值"假设。探针监测与口头置信度是互补的，但没有任何单一干预方法占优，可部署的解决方案是模型感知、错误类型感知的路由。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性探针虽然能以接近完美的准确率检测上下文损坏，但这种检测能力并未转化为可靠的失败预测，这种解离对部署监控有直接影响。论文旨在探究探针检测能力与实际预测可靠性之间的差距，以及不同干预策略的适用性。

Method: 论文在多跳算术链上进行了系统实验：1）测试检测损坏的探针对最终答案正确性的预测能力；2）将模型强制转换为结构化置信度格式，观察其行为；3）检验探针在跳数间的持久性是否能区分正确与错误结果，以验证预注册假设。研究覆盖多个模型家族（包括推理模型），并评估了branch-and-pick、reprompt、replace-prior等多种探针干预策略。

Result: 探针能近乎完美地检测损坏但对答案正确性无预测力；结构化置信度格式中模型坍缩为两个值且错误率无法区分；探针持久性不能分离正确与错误结果，驳斥了"持久性胜过峰值"假设。干预策略中branch-and-pick在所有模型上净正向且在Llama-3.1-8B上唯一不破坏正确轨迹（4救0破），而reprompt和replace-prior破坏正确轨迹与挽救错误轨迹的比率大致相当。

Conclusion: 探针监测是口头置信度的必要补充，但"知道却不表达"（knowing but not saying）的现象普遍存在。没有任何单一干预方法在所有情况下占优，实际部署需要根据具体模型和错误类型进行感知式路由。

Abstract: Linear probes detect corrupted context in language models with near-perfect accuracy, yet this does not translate into reliable failure prediction. The result is a dissociation with direct implications for deployment monitoring. Across multi-hop arithmetic chains, probes that detect corruption turn out to be uninformative about final answer correctness; models forced into structured confidence formats collapse to two values with indistinguishable error rates; and probe persistence across hops fails to separate correct from incorrect outcomes, refuting our pre-registered "persistence beats peak" hypothesis. This pattern of knowing but not saying generalises across model families including reasoning models. As a real-time monitor, probe-based interventions are sharply model and error-type dependent: branch-and-pick is net-positive across models and uniquely non-breaking on Llama-3.1-8B (4 rescued, 0 broken), while reprompt and replace-prior break correct traces at roughly the rate they rescue wrong ones. Probe-based monitoring is a necessary complement to verbalised confidence, but no single intervention dominates, and the deployable answer is model-aware, error-type-aware routing.

</details>


### [561] [NL2SHACL-Bench: A Benchmark Suite for Natural Language to SHACL Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07530)
*Yuchen Zhou,Niels Bobet,Maribel Acosta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了NL2SHACL-Bench，这是首个面向自然语言到SHACL翻译（NL2SHACL）的基准测试套件，并利用该基准评估了四种最先进的大语言模型（LLMs）在生成SHACL形状方面的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SHACL是验证RDF知识图谱一致性的核心技术，但编写SHACL形状需要领域专家通常不具备的技术专长。将自然语言需求翻译为SHACL（NL2SHACL）可以降低这一门槛。然而，目前没有专门的NL2SHACL基准，且评估生成的形状需要超越字符串比较的方法，因为语义等价的形状可能在序列化和结构上不同。

Method: 作者构建了NL2SHACL-Bench基准测试套件，该基准专门用于自然语言到SHACL的翻译任务。利用该基准，作者评估了四种最先进的大语言模型（LLMs）在此任务上的表现，采用语义等价性的评估方法而非简单的字符串比较。

Result: 评估结果显示，当前的大语言模型在生成语法有效的SHACL方面表现出很强的能力，但在为复杂的逻辑和结构模式生成语义等价的约束方面仍然存在困难。

Conclusion: NL2SHACL-Bench为衡量NL2SHACL领域的技术进展提供了有意义的基础，同时也揭示了当前LLMs在处理复杂SHACL约束时的局限性。

Abstract: SHACL is a core technology for validating the conformance of RDF knowledge graphs (KGs). Yet, authoring SHACL shapes requires technical expertise that most domain experts lack. Translating natural language requirements into SHACL (NL2SHACL) would lower this barrier. However, there is no dedicated benchmark for NL2SHACL, and evaluating generated shapes requires methods beyond string comparison, as semantically equivalent shapes can differ in serialisation and structure. To tackle these challenges, we present NL2SHACL-Bench, a benchmark suite for natural language to SHACL translation. Using NL2SHACL-Bench, we evaluate four state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) for this task. Our results show that current LLMs are highly capable of generating syntactically valid SHACL, but still struggle to produce semantically equivalent constraints for complex logical and structural patterns. This indicates that NL2SHACL-Bench provides a meaningful basis for measuring advances in the NL2SHACL state of the art.

</details>


### [562] [An Empirical Study of Coordination Mode as the First-Class Citizen in From-Scratch Multi-Agent Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27877)
*Yanyu Ren,Yunfeng Bai,Xizheng Wang,Li Chen,Dan Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了MSEval，一个基于真实世界任务的多元智能体从零开始编码评估基准，配套LegoGent执行引擎和TAgent自动评分器，通过10个真实全栈项目和10种协作拓扑，揭示了组织结构与模型能力同等重要地影响速度-成本-质量权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多元智能体编码基准依赖合成环境，忽略了实际的时间和金钱成本，将推理与沟通混为一谈，且只奖励表面完成，缺乏对真实软件开发场景的评估。

Method: 构建MSEval基准，包含10个跨领域真实全栈项目，采用分层需求和确定性评分规则；配套LegoGent执行引擎测试10种协作拓扑（通过周期性同步间隔协调并部署到原生CI/CD流水线）；TAgent自动评分器动态探测实现，联合测量功能成功度、延迟和前缀缓存token成本。

Result: 在100次运行中，发现组织结构拓扑与模型能力同样重要地影响速度-成本-质量权衡；相同任务和模型下，改变拓扑可使分数波动超30分并使墙钟时间翻倍；结构化流水线收敛最快且质量最高，而过度管理监督反而降低性能。

Conclusion: MSEval为衡量多元智能体团队如何真正构建软件建立了严格、可复现的标准，基准已开源发布。

Abstract: Multi-agent vibe coding promises to accelerate software development, yet existing benchmarks rely on synthetic environments that ignore practical time and monetary costs, conflate reasoning with communication, and reward only superficial completion. We introduce multi-agent from-scratch evaluation benchmark, MSEval, evaluating multi-agent coding on real-world tasks. Grounded in 10 authentic, full-stack projects across 10 domains, MSEval scores performance using hierarchical requirements and deterministic rubrics.
  Its execution engine, LegoGent, tests 10 collaboration topologies where agents coordinate via periodic sync intervals and deploy through native CI/CD pipelines. Concurrently, the automated grader TAgent dynamically probes implementations to jointly measure functional success, latency, and prefix-cached token cost. Across 100 runs, MSEval reveals that organizational topology rivals model capability in shaping the speed--cost--quality trade-off. For identical tasks and models, varying the topology shifts scores by over 30 points and doubles wall-clock time. Structured pipelines converge fastest with the highest quality, whereas heavy managerial oversight degrades performance. Ultimately, MSEval establishes a rigorous, reproducible standard for measuring how multi-agent teams actually build software. The benchmark is released at https://github.com/robinren03/MSEval.

</details>


### [563] [Dynamic Coalition Formation and Communication Pricing in Skill-Based Agentic AI Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07532)
*Mojtaba Eslami*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个合作博弈框架来建模多智能体LLM系统中的智能体选择与通信优化问题。通过任务条件净效用函数分离联盟级成本与智能体激活成本，提出边际价值激活规则和贪心路由器，并扩展为带边成本的通信边优化。理论证明包括曲率修正界、紧的1/2近似保证以及Shapley-子模性夹逼界。实验表明贪心路由在合成场景中达到暴力搜索最优效用的99.5%，平均激活1.96/8个智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有agentic AI系统在智能体间通信上要么固定通信架构，要么允许全广播，两者都很低效——随着活跃智能体和通信链路的增加，token成本、延迟、冗余和错误传播都会增长。需要一个能动态选择智能体并优化通信结构的框架。

Method: 将智能体选择与通信建模为合作博弈，定义任务条件净效用U(C|x)=V(C|x)-Σc_i。提出边际价值激活规则和贪心路由器；扩展模型以优化带每边成本的通信边；使用估计的Shapley值在执行前后预测值得联系的智能体。与子模最大化建立联系，证明曲率精化界、紧的1/2近似（双贪心，含符号目标修正）、Shapley-子模性夹逼界。

Result: 合成实验中贪心路由达到暴力搜索最优效用的99.5%，平均激活1.96/8个智能体，相比之下全广播仅达38.8%。性能对激活成本和冗余权重鲁棒，但在子模性被强烈违反或值估计有噪声时降至66%。

Conclusion: 作者将该框架与Shapley定价、hedonic联盟形成和通信图剪枝区分开来，提出在真实多智能体LLM基准上进行评估。关键局限是主路由器缺乏直接的理论保证（仅作为启发式使用）。

Abstract: Modern agentic AI systems combine multiple large language model agents with heterogeneous skills, yet most architectures either fix communication in advance or allow full broadcast. Both can be inefficient because token cost, latency, redundancy, and error propagation increase with the number of active agents and communication links. We model agent selection and communication as a cooperative game with task-conditioned net utility $U(C\mid x)=V(C\mid x)-\sum_{i\in C}c_i$, separating coalition-level costs from agent activation costs. We propose a marginal-value activation rule and greedy router, extend the model to optimize communication edges with per-edge costs, and use estimated Shapley values to predict which agents are worth contacting before and during execution. We connect the problem to submodular maximization and prove two limited guarantees: a curvature-refined bound for a monotone, cardinality-constrained special case, and a tight $1/2$-approximation, with a correction for signed objectives, for an unconstrained non-monotone case via double greedy. Neither guarantee applies directly to the main router, which remains a heuristic. We also prove a Shapley-submodularity sandwich bound linking the error of marginal-value routing to a per-agent diminishing-returns quantity. In synthetic experiments, greedy routing achieves $99.5%$ of brute-force-optimal utility while activating $1.96$ of $8$ agents on average, compared with $38.8%$ for full broadcast. Performance is robust to activation cost and redundancy weight but falls to $66%$ under strong violations of submodularity or noisy value estimates. We distinguish the framework from Shapley pricing, hedonic coalition formation, and communication-graph pruning, and propose evaluation on real multi-agent LLM benchmarks.

</details>


### [564] [MetaSpace: Metamorphic Testing for Spatial Cognition in Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07533)
*Gengyang Xu,Dongwei Xiao,Yiteng Peng,Shuai Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MetaSpace框架，借鉴软件工程中的蜕变测试原理，利用真实执行轨迹生成测试用例，通过Prolog编码的蜕变关系来评估具身智能体的空间认知能力，实验发现SOTA多模态大模型驱动智能体的空间认知得分远低于人类基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身智能体评估存在两大缺陷：一是手动标注的VQA对成本高且标注质量不稳定；二是高层任务完成指标可能掩盖智能体通过次优手段或安全违规完成任务的脆弱性。由于空间认知是执行具身任务的基石，迫切需要一种能自动评估智能体执行过程中空间认知能力的框架。

Method: 借鉴软件工程中的蜕变测试原理，提出MetaSpace框架。利用真实执行轨迹中的时空多模态状态，基于逻辑规则和物理定律定义蜕变关系（MRs），并将MRs编码为Prolog可执行规则。通过检测这些关系的违反情况来判断空间认知失败，并引入空间认知（SC）评分来量化性能。

Result: 在三个具身场景中的实验表明，MetaSpace成功检测出SOTA多模态大语言模型驱动智能体中的90,422个空间认知错误。所有SOTA智能体的平均SC得分在0.44到0.52之间，显著低于人类基准的0.96。

Conclusion: 当前最先进的具身智能体在空间认知方面存在显著不足，与人类水平差距巨大。MetaSpace提供了一种自动化、可扩展的评估框架，能够有效揭示智能体在执行过程中隐藏的空间认知缺陷，为改进具身智能体的空间推理能力提供了量化依据。

Abstract: An embodied agent is an intelligent entity that interacts with its environment through a physical body. Currently, the evaluation of embodied agents primarily relies on two paradigms: (1) manually annotated Visual Question Answering (VQA) pairs and (2) high-level task completion metrics, such as success in navigation or manipulation. The former is labor-intensive and subject to variability in annotation quality. The latter may obscure critical vulnerabilities, allowing agents to complete tasks through suboptimal means or safety violations, thereby concealing safety risks and inefficiencies. Given that spatial cognition is the cornerstone for executing embodied tasks, there is a pressing need to assess whether embodied agents possess robust spatial cognition during task execution.
  Inspired by metamorphic testing principles in software engineering, we propose MetaSpace, a novel framework designed to evaluate the spatial cognition of agents. By leveraging spatiotemporal multimodal states derived from real execution trajectories, MetaSpace automatically generates test cases based on predefined metamorphic relations (MRs) grounded in logical rules and physical laws. Crucially, we encode these MRs as executable rules in a logic programming language (Prolog). Violations of these relations indicate failures in spatial cognition. Our empirical evaluation across three embodied scenarios demonstrates that MetaSpace successfully detects 90,422 spatial cognition errors in state-of-the-art (SOTA) MLLM-driven agents. We introduce the Spatial Cognition (SC) score to quantify performance. Results indicate that all SOTA agents achieve average scores between 0.44 and 0.52, significantly lower than the human benchmark of 0.96.

</details>


### [565] [When LLM Agents Negotiate: Private Information and Dynamic Bargaining in Supply Chains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07538)
*Chen Liang,Fasheng Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究LLM代理在供应链讨价还价中的表现，通过与已验证的完美贝叶斯均衡基准对比9个LLM模型进行的9840场代理间谈判，从折扣效率、分配特征和操作可靠性三个维度审计AI代理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM代理从决策支持转向自主采购，企业需要了解被委派的谈判代理是否能创造价值、能否可预测地分配价值，以及是否会接受亏损合同。这些关键问题尚未有系统性回答。

Method: 在经典的供应链讨价还价问题（买方拥有私人需求信息，与不知情卖方谈判数量-支付合同）中，将OpenAI、Google和Alibaba的9个LLM与经过验证的完美贝叶斯均衡进行对比基准测试，进行9840场LLM对LLM的谈判。

Result: （1）能力决定价值创造：98.9%谈判达成一致，捕获95.4%的未贴现最优剩余，但平均2.98轮谈判对比基准的1.25轮，延迟侵蚀21-34%的剩余；基线模型在19.2%案例中接受非理性合同。（2）剩余捕获具有关系性：供应商身份比能力排名更能预测谁捕获剩余——OpenAI自博弈买方平均分得40%，Google为50%，Alibaba的Qwen为70%；翻转提供商角色可改变7-18个百分点的分配。（3）提示词是战略杠杆：委托将委托人的经济耐心与代理的提示性战略耐心分离开来，这是剩余分配的最强驱动因素（占解释方差的90%）。

Conclusion: 确立了沿着三个维度的AI代理均衡参照审计框架：折扣效率、分配特征和操作可靠性，为企业在自主采购中部署LLM谈判代理提供了系统性评估维度。

Abstract: As LLM agents move from decision support to autonomous procurement, firms need to know whether delegated negotiators create value, divide it predictably, and avoid money-losing contracts. We study this in a canonical supply chain bargaining problem: a buyer with private demand information negotiates a quantity-payment contract with an uninformed seller. We benchmark nine LLMs from OpenAI, Google, and Alibaba against a validated Perfect Bayesian Equilibrium across 9,840 LLM-to-LLM negotiations. First, capability governs value creation. Agents agree in 98.9% of negotiations and capture 95.4% of first-best surplus undiscounted, but average 2.98 rounds against the benchmark's 1.25, and this delay erodes 21-34% of surplus. Capability also governs reliability: baseline models accept individually irrational contracts in 19.2% of cases, versus 0.0-0.6% at mid-tier and flagship, making automated profit verification the binding guardrail below that threshold. Second, surplus capture is relational. Provider identity predicts who captures surplus better than capability rank: self-play buyer shares average 40% for OpenAI, 50% for Google, and 70% for Alibaba's Qwen, an ordering that survives restricted communication and no discounting. Reversing which provider sells moves the division by 7-18 percentage points, and the capable Qwen flagship is the weakest cross-family seller: vendor choice is a first-order distributional decision. Third, the prompt is a strategic lever. Delegation separates the principal's economic patience from the agent's prompted strategic patience, a free deployment choice that is the single strongest driver of surplus division (90% of explained variance). Together these establish an equilibrium-referenced audit of AI agents along three dimensions: discounted efficiency, distributional profile, and operational reliability.

</details>


### [566] [An AI Scientist that Doesn't Drift: Taste, Structure, and Falsifiable Findings in a Quadruped Navigation Research Loop](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07542)
*Yiwen Zhang,Eloise Zeng,Jaeha Lee,Tony Yue Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于四足机器人导航策略泛化研究的AI科学家系统，通过不可变实验卡、专职子代理和kkanbu偏好预言机三个组件，解决了自主研究循环中漂移到局部最优而非检验假设的问题。实验表明，有无kkanbu的两个循环都不会漂移，但kkanbu决定了研究方向和探索领域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型驱动的自主研究循环虽然能大规模运行机器学习实验，但倾向于对所选指标进行局部优化，而非检验驱动实验的假设。作者希望通过结构性方法解决这一"漂移"问题。

Method: 在Karpathy的autoresearch范式基础上增加三个组件：1）不可变实验卡，以固定模式将每次迭代的预测与结果配对，防止伪造假设；2）专职子代理，限定机械性角色；3）kkanbu偏好预言机，以类型化知识图谱存储用户研究品味，是唯一允许做主观判断的组件。作者运行两组完全相同的循环（有无kkanbu）跨11个研究方向进行隔离测试。

Result: 两组循环均未漂移，各自证明了约四分之三的假设，最佳训练策略来自无预言机的组。kkanbu改变的并非得分而是方向：它独自主导了测试时适应的探索，在其领导的研究流中创作了胜出设计，并将经验跨研究流传递，而另一组反复重新推导这些经验。

Conclusion: 脚手架机制保证了循环的诚实性（不漂移），而kkanbu决定了研究的方向和探索重点。框架负责"诚实"，预言机负责"方向"。

Abstract: Autonomous research loops driven by large language models can run machine-learning experiments at scale but tend to drift toward local refinements of whichever metric they optimise rather than testing the hypotheses that motivate the experiments. We address this structurally and present an AI Scientist for studying generalisation in quadruped robot navigation policies in simulation. Building on the autoresearch paradigm of Karpathy, our loop adds three components: an immutable experiment card that pairs each iteration's prediction with its outcome under a fixed schema, so a falsified hypothesis cannot be retconned; specialised subagents restricted to mechanical roles; and kkanbu, a preference oracle that holds the user's research taste as a typed knowledge graph and is the only component permitted to make subjective judgements. To isolate the oracle we run the identical loop twice across eleven research streams, with and without kkanbu. Neither arm drifts: both falsify roughly three quarters of their own hypotheses, and the best trained policy comes from the oracle-less arm. What the oracle changes is direction, not score: it alone explores test-time adaptation, it authored the winning designs where its arm led, and it carried lessons across streams that the other arm repeatedly re-derived. The scaffold keeps the loop honest; kkanbu decides where it looks.

</details>


### [567] [TREAT: Evaluating Access to Formal Knowledge across Equivalent Mathematical Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07540)
*Fateme Mazdarani,Carlos Toxtli*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了TREAT基准，一个用于评估大型语言模型能否在等价变换下识别定理身份（identity）的基准。TREAT包含737条定理和29,480个经过等价保持的公式变换样本，最佳模型仅达到60.73%的准确率，揭示了LLM在表示变化下对形式知识的脆弱性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI系统在灵活输入表示和形式对象之间运作，核心挑战是识别不熟悉的表述是否对应已知的形式对象。现有研究多聚焦于文本层面的改写（paraphrasing），而本文关注更深层的数学形式变换——即在公式层面改变定理条件的表达方式，测试模型能否跨越表示差异恢复定理身份。

Method: TREAT从爬取的定理页面出发，筛选具有可用数学表达式的条目，提取规范定理条件，并生成多种等价变换变体（包括残差方程、存在性陈述、优化恒等式、集合关系、算子形式和证明中间形式），同时记录假设条件和逆映射，构建带标注的基准数据集。

Result: 最终语料库包含737条定理身份和29,480行变换数据。在测试面板上，最佳模型仅能正确检索60.73%的定理身份。不同系统表现出不同失败模式：放弃回答、错误检测和格式错误输出。

Conclusion: 结果表明定理知识在等价表示变换下是脆弱的，TREAT为评估形式知识的表示鲁棒性提供了受控测试平台，其方法可推广到需要稳定目标对象、显式等价关系、验证流程和可审计评分机制的更广泛领域。

Abstract: AI systems increasingly operate between flexible input representations and formal objects used by downstream tools. A key challenge is recognizing when an unfamiliar formulation denotes a known formal object. We study this challenge through theorem recognition: given an equivalence-preserving transformation of a theorem condition, a model must recover the theorem identity associated with the standard statement. We introduce TREAT, a benchmark for evaluating whether large language models can recover known theorem identities from equivalence-preserving formula-level transformations. Rather than paraphrasing theorem text, TREAT changes the mathematical form of theorem conditions themselves, expressing known results through residual equations, witness statements, optimization identities, set relations, operator forms, and proof-intermediate characterizations. Starting from scraped theorem pages, we filter for entries with usable mathematical expression forms, extract canonical theorem conditions, and generate transformed variants with recorded assumptions and inverse mappings. The final corpus contains 737 theorem identities and 29,480 transformed rows. On a test panel, the best model retrieves the correct theorem identity in only 60.73% of cases. Other systems reveal different failure modes, including abstention, wrong detection, and malformed outputs. These suggest that theorem knowledge can be fragile under equivalent changes in representation. TREAT therefore provides a controlled testbed for evaluating representation-robust access to formal knowledge, with broader relevance to domains that require stable target objects, explicit equivalence relations, validation procedures, and auditable scoring.

</details>


### [568] [From Single Chatbots to Governed Agent Ecosystems: An Agentic AI Pattern Catalogue and Orchestration Framework for Mission-Critical Hospital Information Management Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07627)
*Manideep Dhar,Ritwik Singh,Sharat Chandra Kumar Manikonda*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向医院信息管理系统（HIMS）的合规优先Agentic AI模式目录和编排框架，通过引入智能体角色分类、风险分层模型和统一编排运行时，旨在解决医院AI部署碎片化、治理缺失和规模化失败的问题，最终在符合HIPAA、GDPR、EU AI Act等法规的前提下，将AI投资转化为可持续的临床、运营和财务回报。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医院在竞相部署AI，但多数部署仍是停留在生产边缘的碎片化试点，暴露出运营脆弱性、无治理风险和不断累积的技术债务。同时AI医疗市场预计2034年将接近1万亿美元，架构失误和规模化失败的经济后果被放大。现有方案仅停留在单一LLM聊天机器人层面，缺乏面向HIMS的合规治理和编排体系。

Method: 提出一个合规优先的Agentic AI模式目录与编排框架，包含三个核心组件：(i) Agentic角色分类法，(ii) 形式化风险分层模型（将每个模式映射到风险层级、人在环检查点和治理钩子），(iii) 统一编排运行时（可跨Epic、Cerner、MEDITECH等EHR/HIMS系统协调多智能体工作流）。技术上结合vLLM推理、优化分页内存、机密计算和基于MCP的本地部署，通过端到端加密和策略即代码实现对HIPAA、GDPR、EU AI Act、DPDP/DISHA、ISO等法规的合规。

Result: 所提出架构能够有效减少文档记录时间、降低集成工作量、减少AI试点流失率，同时加强治理与可审计性，为医院领导者和监管机构提供了将AI投资转化为可持续临床、运营和财务ROI的蓝图。

Conclusion: 该框架填补了医院AI从碎片化试点走向受治理的生产级部署之间的关键空白，为医疗行业提供了一套可落地、合规优先的Agentic AI编排蓝图，能够在满足多法规要求的同时实现实际商业价值。

Abstract: Hospitals are racing to embed AI, while coping with the surge in adaptation of the technology in other industries, into the triage management, documentation, scheduling, and revenue-cycle workflows, yet most deployments remain as fragmented pilots that stall at the edge of production, exposing patients and institutions to operational fragility, ungoverned risk, and mounting technical debt. At the same time, the global AI-in-healthcare market is projected to exceed nearly USD 1 trillion by 2034, according to the report of Fortune Business Insights, amplifying the financial consequences of architectural missteps and failed scaling strategies. This research proposes a compliance-first Agentic AI pattern catalogue and orchestration framework, purposely built for HIMS, moving beyond the single LLM chatbots and towards a governed ecosystem of autonomous and semi-autonomous agents. The framework extends by adding (i) a taxonomy of Agentic roles, (ii) a formal risk-stratification model that maps each pattern to risk tiers, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and governance hooks, and (iii) a unified orchestration runtime capable of coordinating multi-agent workflows across EHR/HIMS landscapes such as Epic, Cerner, and MEDITECH.
